Title: Retail Data Analysis
Description:
Job Description:

Data Management

Take overall responsibility for the accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of retail data.
Ensure SO (Sales Out) information is entered into RMS system completely, accurately, and on time, including:
Organization and retailer master data
Store master data
Employee/store relationship data
Store-retailer relationship data
Business rules, including sales, inventory, assortment, and expense calculation rules
Ensure RMS data remains complete, accurate, and up to date.

System Implementation & Adoption

Follow the implementation roadmap and drive the adoption of key data functionalities within the region.
Support the rollout and adoption of new modules, features, and business processes.
Ensure new RMS functions are implemented and effectively used by local teams within the required timeline.

Issue Resolution & Continuous Improvement

Collect and manage local business and system issues, including:
System performance issues
Functionality issues
User experience issues
Business process issues
Provide timely feedback and follow up with the relevant teams until issues are resolved.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve system functionality and business processes.




Key Technical Skills

Data Analysis & Visualization

Proficient in Python for data analysis, with hands-on experience using Pandas, NumPy, and Matplotlib/Seaborn.
Able to perform data processing, analysis, and visualization.
Familiar with commonly used data analysis methodologies.

SQL

Proficient in MySQL and SQL query development.
Capable of independently extracting, processing, and analyzing data from databases.
Able to use Power BI to connect to and visualize data from multiple sources and build complete dashboards and analytical reports.

Excel

Proficient in advanced Excel functions.
Experienced in creating PivotTables, charts, and other analytical reports.
Able to efficiently handle daily data analysis and reporting tasks.

Language

Fluent in Italian, Chinese and English.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
LA TUA NUOVA AZIENDA

Kirey è uno dei principali gruppi europei attivi nella consulenza tecnologica e nella system integration, con un posizionamento distintivo nell’ambito della data-driven innovation.

Attraverso un portafoglio completo di soluzioni che include Data & AI, Cloud, Software Development, Cybersecurity, Infrastructure & Automation e Monitoring, Kirey trasforma la complessità dei dati in soluzioni intuitive e accessibili, facilitando i propri clienti nel raggiungimento degli obiettivi di business.

Con sede principale in Italia, una presenza internazionale consolidata e quasi 1.500 dipendenti, Kirey ha realizzato più di 10.000 progetti per clienti leader nei settori Insurance, Banking, Manufacturing, Retail, Pubblica Amministrazione e Services & Energy.

Alla base di tutto questo ci sono le persone, che in Kirey trovano spazio per esprimere al massimo il proprio talento e per sentirsi parte attiva nella catena del valore dell'azienda. Ciò è possibile grazie a: investimenti costanti nei processi di miglioramento, attraverso la formazione; idee innovative e stimolo alla creatività, grazie al consolidamento delle competenze; e, ancora, a una particolare sensibilità - che si esprime in progetti ad hoc - nei confronti dell'inclusione e della diversità.




IL TUO RUOLO

Siamo alla ricerca di una persona da inserire come Data Analyst per potenziare il team FS Applied Intelligence.




REWSPONSABILITA'




Attività di configurazione e manutenzione procedure







REQUISITI

Power BI (conoscenza obbligatoria di DAX, Power Query, Report Development)
SQL
PL/SQL desiderabile
SAS







CHI STIAMO CERCANDO

Il candidato ideale ha almeno 2-3 anni di esperienza nel ruolo di Data Analyst ed ottime capacità relazionali e di problem solving. Completa il profilo una buona conoscenza della lingua inglese.




COSA OFFRIAMO

La retribuzione proposta prevede una RAL compresa tra €30.000 e €34.000, commisurata alle competenze e all’esperienza maturata.

INOLTRE OFFRIAMO

Progetti complessi ed innovativi
Ambiente dinamico e meritocratico
Lavoro in team con metodologia Agile
Piano di crescita professionale
Corsi di formazione e certificazioni
Sistema di Welfare&Benefits
Smart working o full remote ( reali❗) con orario flessibile




UNISCITI A NOI

Sede di lavoro: Milano, Hybrid

Abbiamo una strategia di Hybrid work che è progettata per sfruttare il potere delle opportunità che il lavoro a distanza offre sia ai dipendenti che all'Azienda. Il nostro approccio all'ambiente di lavoro riflette la convinzione che l'impatto, il contributo e il risultato di un dipendente sono più importanti della sua posizione fisica.

Kirey sostiene la diversità nel suo ambiente di lavoro. Tutte le candidature per le posizioni aperte saranno accolte con favore e saranno considerate in base ai meriti.

I tuoi dati saranno trattati per la selezione del personale (esecuzione misure precontrattuali) da soggetti, anche esterni, coinvolti nella selezione del Titolare, Kirey S.r.l., con sede legale in Viale Francesco Restelli, 5 - 20124 Milano, nella persona del Legale Rappresentante protempore, e/o dalle altre Società sottoposte al suo controllo e coordinamento, che può contattare all’indirizzo e-mail privacy@kireygroup.com, a cui potrà rivolgersi per esercitare i Suoi diritti (ex artt. 15-22 GDPR), compreso eventuale reclamo al Garante Privacy. I dati saranno conservati massimo 24 mesi (salvo eventi interruttivi o sospensivi) e, in ogni caso, non saranno diffusi. Esperienza nell’analisi dei dati su database relazionali, con particolare attenzione alle tecnologie Oracle, e conoscenza dei principali oggetti database (tabelle, viste, indici, partizioni, procedure, sinonimi)

Competenze nella modellazione dei dati a livello concettuale, logico e fisico

Title: Data Analyst (Excel e Power BI)
Description:
Per un nostro business partner, leader europeo in ambito Connected Devices e Smart Home, stiamo cercando un/una Data Analyst con forte orientamento all’analisi dei dati e ottima capacità di gestione di grandi volumi informativi.

La risorsa si occuperà di analizzare, strutturare e visualizzare dati a supporto dei processi decisionali aziendali.







In particolare ti occuperai di :




Analisi e gestione di grandi moli di dati
Creazione e utilizzo avanzato di Excel, incluse tabelle pivot
Creazione di grafici e visualizzazioni efficaci
Supporto alle funzioni aziendali tramite analisi quantitative
Collaborazione con team interni e stakeholder




Must Have:







Conoscenza avanzata di Microsoft Excel
Ottima padronanza delle tabelle pivot
Capacità di gestire grandi volumi di dati
Esperienza nella creazione di grafici e report
Conoscenza di Power BI
Inglese B2




Le soft skills che riteniamo importanti







Siamo alla ricerca di una persona con propensione al problem-solving, proattiva, propensa a trasmettere la propria esperienza alle figure più junior, oltre che flessibile e motivata.







Dedicated to Growth







Che si tratti di un software, di una soluzione tecnologica o di una consulenza, al cuore di ogni progetto ci sono sempre persone che lavorano insieme ad altre persone.

Competenti e curiose, ambiziose e tenaci: alle Deda People piace imparare, confrontarsi, migliorare. La dedizione, per noi, è attitudine al miglioramento continuo, ricerca di obiettivi sempre nuovi, raggiungimento di risultati e capacità di lavorare insieme. ll nostro impegno è far crescere le persone perché possano migliorare, esprimere al meglio il proprio potenziale e contribuire alla costruzione di un futuro migliore: per sé, per Deda e per la società tutta.




I nostri annunci sono rivolti alle candidate e ai candidati di qualsiasi espressione di genere, orientamento sessuale, età, etnia e credo religioso (ai sensi dei D.Lgs. 198/2006, D.Lgs. 215/2003, D.Lgs. 216/2003). I dati acquisiti con la ricezione dei curriculum vitae sono trattati da Dedagroup S.p.A. al fine di valutare il possibile interesse alla futura costituzione di un rapporto contrattuale. Tali informazioni potranno essere trasmesse alle varie società appartenenti al Gruppo Dedagroup secondo quanto previsto nell’Informativa Privacy.

Title: Data Analyst - Omnicommerce & HR
Description:
Leroy Merlin, brand internazionale del gruppo Adeo, leader nel settore retail home improvement, bricolage e fai-da-te, è presente nelle principali città italiane con una missione chiara: aiutare le persone a realizzare i loro progetti di casa e di vita, offrendo soluzioni innovative e ad alto impatto positivo.




Chi cerchiamo:

Stiamo cercando un/una Data Analyst da inserire nel team Analytics della direzione Finance & Performance. Con un focus prevalente sull’area Omnicommerce e Human Resources, il ruolo agisce come partner strategico del business sulle due aree di riferimento e in tre principali declinazioni: Cliente, Customer Care operations e Produttività.







Responsabilità del ruolo:

Collabora ed è di supporto ai propri stakeholder e ne comprende problemi, obiettivi e priorità, detenendo ownership su identificazione e implementazione delle soluzioni.
E’ domain expert del mondo Cliente e Collaboratore interno, contribuendo al miglioramento dei principali KPI operativi e finanziari tramite analisi delle performance operative e commerciali (es. analisi eventi promozionali, kpi post-vendita, produttività).
Ha ownership sulla gestione della data platform aziendale insieme al team Data Engineering per le aree di propria competenza.
Sviluppa dashboard, analisi e prodotti data, con grande attenzione alla trasmissibilità degli stessi in un’ottica di industrializzazione degli asset.
Prioritizza e gestisce in autonomia backlog e priorità, privilegiando attività a maggior valore aggiunto, in accordo con gli stakeholder di business.
Comunica i risultati del proprio lavoro in modo chiaro e accessibile, favorendone la comprensione e garantendo - quando possibile - una stima dell'impatto delle decisioni prese grazie al proprio contributo.
Diffonde competenze e best practice analitiche verso i team con cui collabora, è punto di riferimento per Business Partner e Performance Leader.







Qualifiche e competenze:

Almeno 3 anni di esperienza in ruolo analogo.
Padronanza di SQL e buona familiarità con Python.
Attitudine problem-first e comprovata esperienza nella capacità di definire il successo di iniziative basandosi su outcome (risultati finali / impatto) vs output (deliverable di progetto).
Esperienza con metodologie statistiche e modelli predittivi, in particolare nel ramo disciplinare del marketing e dell’analisi di incrementalità (uplift modeling, causal inference, counterfactual analysis).
Conoscenza di strumenti di analisi e visualizzazione dati (es. Power BI, Tableau, Looker)
Conoscenza della lingua inglese fluente
Plus: Conoscenza applicata di strumenti AI agentici (e.g. Claude Code, Codex).







Cosa offriamo:

Percorsi di crescita internazionali – Mobilità interna Gruppo Adeo
Formazione continua – training on the job + learning platform digitale
Per questa posizione è previsto un range retributivo annuo lordo compreso tra 34.500 e 48.000. La proposta economica sarà commisurata all'esperienza, alle competenze e al percorso professionale, nel rispetto dell'inquadramento previsto per il ruolo.
Sistema incentivante e Azionariato diffuso
Sconti collaboratori
Assistenza sanitaria (FondoEst)







In Leroy Merlin crediamo nella diversità come leva fondamentale per il nostro successo e accogliamo con favore le candidature di tutti i membri della società.




Il tuo percorso in Leroy Merlin inizia da qui! Candidati ora e inizia la tua crescita con noi.

Title: Data Analist Professional
Description:
Wat jij mag verwachten

Als Data Analyst Professional speel je een sleutelrol in het ontwerpen en uitbouwen van ons centrale datamodel en de semantische laag. Je werkt met moderne tools zoals Microsoft Fabric, DBT en Power BI en neemt ownership over modellering, standaarden en best practices. Daarnaast ben je een belangrijke sparringpartner voor collega’s en help je hen groeien in expertise.Je rapporteert aan de Teamlead Resource Pool Data en werkt voornamelijk op de gold layer, waar je businessnoden vertaalt naar consistente, schaalbare datamodellen die écht gebruikt worden.
Zo ziet jouw takenpakket eruit
Je ontwerpt en implementeert robuuste, businessgerichte datamodellen in DBT (dimensioneel, business-driven).
Je bouwt en onderhoudt het centrale datamodel (gold layer).
Je definieert en bewaakt standaarden rond modellering, naming conventions en versioning.
Je integreert data uit verschillende bronnen tot één coherent en herbruikbaar geheel.
Je waakt over data-consistentie, kwaliteit en herbruikbaarheid.
Je werkt nauw samen met data engineers (brondata → silver → gold).
Je vertaalt businessvragen naar KPI’s, measures en semantische definities.
Je maakt self-service analytics mogelijk via duidelijke datasets en governance.
Je fungeert als sparringpartner voor business stakeholders.
Je geeft gerichte opleidingen over het gebruik en de inhoud van semantische modellen.
Je stimuleert kennisdeling en draagt bij aan de verdere maturiteit van het team.

Must‑haves



Sterke ervaring (enkele jaren) in datamodellering en analytics
Aantoonbare ervaring met DBT (modelling, testing, documentation)
Zeer goede kennis van SQL
Ervaring met Power BI (focus op datasets en semantische modellen)
Sterk inzicht in dimensionele modellering (facts & dimensions)
Ervaring in samenwerking met data engineers en stakeholders
Sterke analytische en communicatieve vaardigheden



Nice‑to‑haves



Ervaring met Microsoft Fabric of gelijkaardige platforms
Ervaring met data governance tools (bv. Purview)
Kennis van Git, data contracten en CI/CD
Ervaring in Agile/Scrum omgevingen

Title: Data & Simulation Specialist
Description:
Cartamundi is wereldmarktleider in “play”-oplossingen. Denk aan speelkaarten, kaart- en bordspellen, collectibles en trading card games.

Ons doel? “Live Different, Play Different” voor iedereen. Met bijna 3.000 mensen zetten we ons elke dag in om die ambitie waar te maken. Ons familiebedrijf, met hoofdkantoor in België, heeft daarvoor een wereldwijd netwerk van designcenters, verkoopkantoren en productiefaciliteiten. Een netwerk dat loopt van de VS en Brazilië tot Europa en Japan.

Cartamundi heeft een wereldwijde merkenportefeuille met heritage brands zoals Bicycle®, Bee®, Copag®, Shuffle® en heel wat lokaal geliefde merken. We zijn ook de vertrouwde partner van toonaangevende speelgoed- en entertainmentbedrijven voor productie- en distributieoplossingen.

De drukpersen van Cartamundi draaien al sinds 1765. We koppelen die rijke traditie aan innovatie in digitale en hybride speelervaringen. Om zo relevant te blijven – vandaag en morgen.

Cartamundi voert een strategie van duurzame en winstgevende groei. Op die manier streven we ernaar om onze planeet en ons bedrijf in topconditie te houden voor de komende generaties.




Lees meer op www.cartamundi.com

Volg ons op LinkedIn: www.linkedin.com/company/cartamundi




Data & Simulation Analyst

Als Data & Simulation Analyst ben je verantwoordelijk voor het vertalen van complexe en unieke klantbehoeften naar correcte, efficiënte en productieklare collatieschema’s voor collectible kaartenproducten.

Je zorgt ervoor dat alle kaartvarianten in de juiste aantallen, samenstellingen en configuraties in flowpacks, decks en displays terechtkomen, in lijn met zowel klantverwachtingen als productietechnische mogelijkheden.




Jouw functie

Met jouw analytische blik en technische feeling…




…Vertaal je klantbehoeften naar haalbare oplossingen

Je analyseert klantwensen en adviseert op basis van technische en statistische inzichten.




…Ontwerp je collatieschema’s van A tot Z

Je ontwikkelt vorm-, lay‑out- en dropschema’s en zorgt voor correcte kaartcombinaties.
Je maakt scenario­berekeningen voor duidelijke keuzes en alternatieven.




…Lever je sterke simulaties en analyses

Je bouwt displaysimulaties op basis van kansberekening.
Je maakt impactanalyses en rapporten die beslissingen ondersteunen.




…Bewaak je data en kwaliteit

Je houdt namelists en control sheets up-to-date.
Je voert nauwkeurige 4‑eyes checks uit.




…Optimaliseer je tools en processen

Je verbetert bestaande tools en workflows en ondersteunt toolontwikkeling.




…Communiceer je vlot met interne partners

Je stemt af met Sales en productie en maakt technische info begrijpelijk voor iedereen.




Jouw profiel

Je bent voor ons de ideale kandidaat omdat je…

Denkt op masterniveau en een wetenschappelijke of wiskundige achtergrond hebt.
Sterke analytische skills hebt en vaardig bent in statistische berekeningen.
Nauwkeurig werkt, een oog hebt voor detail en steeds gaat voor topkwaliteit (4 eyes mindset zit in jouw DNA).
Complexe materie helder kan uitleggen en graag meedenkt in oplossingen.
Uitblinkt in Excel. Basis tot programmeervaardigheden is mooi meegenomen.
De taal van zowel Sales als Productie begrijpt en deze werelden moeiteloos met elkaar verbindt.
Proactief verbeterkansen ziet en graag werkt aan efficiëntere processen en slimmere tools.
Je jezelf vlot kan uitdrukken in het Nederlands en Engels.




Aanbod

We bieden je de uitdaging om zelfstandig een boeiende en gevarieerde job uit te oefenen. Je komt terecht in een dynamische onderneming en een hecht team waar je kan werken in een aangename werksfeer. Je krijgt de mogelijkheden jezelf te ontwikkelen. Het salarispakket is in overeenstemming met je ervaring en de verantwoordelijkheden van de functie.

Title: Data Analyst/Engineer
Description:
We are wizards who turn data into knowledge. We execute E2E projects in team and work as consultants for various clients (and sectors) – partly on-site/partly from home – to assist them with Microsoft data solutions. Our credo is to empower every professional to make the best data-driven decision. Transforming data into usable knowledge is something you have right at your fingertips.




Your role as a Data Analyt/Engineer

Within this role, you will also contribute to data modelling activities in Power BI environments or data warehouses, translating business requirements into structured data models and validating them with stakeholders.




Managing and customising the ETL or ELT process (Extract, transform, load)

Setting up and customising data integrations and data modelling (SSIS , SSAS, SSRS)

You will be using Microsoft data services on-premise or in Azure, or a combination of both.




Project-based or long-term assignments, all options are on the table. Depending on the assignment, you may be working on your own or in a team, taking care of the project management yourself or not. Participating in pre-sales is also a possibility. The trump cards of this job are variety and continuous learning through experience.




But don’t worry.




The roles within assignments and their complexity will be tailored to you: sufficiently challenging for learning and not over your head. If you demonstrate a keenness to learn, independence and initiative, you will be absolutely fine. Don’t forget that you have a team of helpful Koherians standing behind you who will be happy to help you and facilitate your development.




Experience and Technical skills

3 to 6 years of experience in a Data Analyst, Data Engineer or similar data role
Hands-on experience with Power BI
Experience with Azure Data Lake services
Strong knowledge of T-SQL and ETL development using Azure components or on-premise tools such as Azure Data Factory or SSIS
Experience with Azure Data Factory, Microsoft Fabric or Azure Synapse Analytics is an asset
Knowledge of Python or Databricks is a plus




Languages

Fluency in Dutch and English is a must, and fluency in French would be a bonus.




Are you our next Data Wizard? Don't hesitate and apply!

Title: Datamanager
Description:
Binnen deze organisatie wordt een nieuwe rol van Data Engineer gecreëerd. Geen functie die al volledig in beton gegoten is, maar net een positie waarin je mee bepaalt welke richting je uitgaat. Je krijgt ruimte om verbeteringen te initiëren, projecten vast te pakken en met jouw analyses een directe impact te hebben op de werking en resultaten van de organisatie.




Je werkt rond pricing, productdata, procurement en procesoptimalisatie en krijgt daarbij de nodige verantwoordelijkheid én budgetten om ideeën ook daadwerkelijk te realiseren.

Jouw projecten en verantwoordelijkheden

Je analyseert prijs-, verkoop- en marktdata en vertaalt inzichten naar concrete acties.
Je beheert en optimaliseert de prijzenmatrix en wordt back-up voor de collega die de pricing mee bepaalt.
Je trekt projecten rond pricing, marktanalyse en procesoptimalisatie.
Je onderzoekt waar calculatie- en bedrijfsprocessen efficiënter kunnen.
Je vergelijkt het assortiment en prijsniveau met de markt en denkt mee over nieuwe producten.
Je onderhandelt mee met leveranciers en neemt een actieve rol op binnen procurement.
Je groeit uit tot een aanspreekpunt voor collega's en interne stakeholders.




De organisatie staat voor een belangrijke digitale transitie: de huidige software wordt vervangen door een nieuwe oplossing. Dat wordt één van de eerste projecten waarin je je tanden kunt zetten.




Wat zoeken we?

Je bent iemand die graag begrijpt waarom iets werkt zoals het werkt en vervolgens ook nadenkt over hoe het beter kan. Data, cijfers en processen spreken je aan, maar je verliest daarbij het commerciële plaatje niet uit het oog.

Je beschikt over een masterdiploma, of gelijkwaardig door ervaring in het vooropgestelde takenpakket.
Je hebt een sterk analytisch denkvermogen en werkt graag nauwkeurig en gestructureerd.
Complexe data of processen schrikken je niet af: je duikt erin, legt verbanden en komt graag tot een onderbouwd advies.
Je neemt graag zelf initiatief en voelt je goed bij een functie waarin je ruimte krijgt om zaken vast te pakken en verder uit te werken.
Naast je analytische blik heb je ook een commerciële ingesteldheid. Je begrijpt dat een goede pricingstrategie niet alleen technisch klopt, maar ook moet werken in de praktijk.
Je bent nieuwsgierig en leert graag bij, zeker wanneer het gaat over software, data, pricing of procesoptimalisatie.
Excel kent voor jou weinig geheimen. Ervaring met ERP-systemen of bijvoorbeeld Odoo is mooi meegenomen.
Je bent matuur in je aanpak en communiceert vlot met verschillende stakeholders, van collega's tot leveranciers.
Je spreekt zeer goed Nederlands. Frans is een sterke troef, maar geen absolute must.




Wat bieden we?

Je komt terecht in een organisatie die actief is in de wereld van ramen en deuren en is de drijvende kracht achter twee sterke merken! Via een uitgebreid franchisenetwerk zijn de merken actief in België, Nederland en Frankrijk. Vanuit het hoofdkantoor worden de franchisepartners ondersteund met onder meer producten, pricing, calculatie, processen en digitale oplossingen.

De organisatie telt over de drie landen heen zo’n 1.000 medewerkers. Jouw werk heeft daardoor een bredere impact: de processen en oplossingen waar jij aan meewerkt, ondersteunen een groot netwerk van medewerkers en franchisepartners.

Je krijgt de tijd om de organisatie, producten en processen grondig te leren kennen via een uitgebreid onboardingtraject. Daarna kan de functie verder evolueren volgens jouw talenten en interesses.




€3.700 – €5.600 bruto / maand
bedrijfswagen
maaltijdcheques van €8
groeps- en hospitalisatieverzekering

Je krijgt ruimte om verbeteringen te initiëren, projecten vast te pakken en met jouw analyses een directe impact te hebben op de werking en resultaten van de organisatie.


Je werkt rond pricing, productdata, procurement en procesoptimalisatie en krijgt daarbij de nodige verantwoordelijkheid én budgetten om ideeën ook daadwerkelijk te realiseren.

Jouw projecten en verantwoordelijkheden

  • Je analyseert prijs-, verkoop- en marktdata en vertaalt inzichten naar concrete acties.
  • Je beheert en optimaliseert de prijzenmatrix en wordt back-up voor de collega die de pricing mee bepaalt.
  • Je trekt projecten rond pricing, marktanalyse en procesoptimalisatie.
  • Je onderzoekt waar calculatie- en bedrijfsprocessen efficiënter kunnen.

  • Je onderhandelt mee met leveranciers en neemt een actieve rol op binnen procurement.
  • Je groeit uit tot een aanspreekpunt voor collega's en interne stakeholders.


De organisatie staat voor een belangrijke digitale transitie: de huidige software wordt vervangen door een nieuwe oplossing. Dat wordt één van de eerste projecten waarin je je tanden kunt zetten.


Wat zoeken we?

Je bent iemand die graag begrijpt waarom iets werkt zoals het werkt en vervolgens ook nadenkt over hoe het beter kan. Data, cijfers en processen spreken je aan, maar je verliest daarbij het commerciële plaatje niet uit het oog.

  • Je neemt graag zelf initiatief en voelt je goed bij een functie waarin je ruimte krijgt om zaken vast te pakken en verder uit te werken.
  • Naast je analytische blik heb je ook een commerciële ingesteldheid. Je begrijpt dat een goede pricingstrategie niet alleen technisch klopt, maar ook moet werken in de praktijk.

  • Excel kent voor jou weinig geheimen. Ervaring met ERP-systemen of bijvoorbeeld Odoo is mooi meegenomen.
  • Je bent matuur in je aanpak en communiceert vlot met verschillende stakeholders, van collega's tot leveranciers.
  • Je spreekt zeer goed Nederlands. Frans is een sterke troef, maar geen absolute must.


Wat bieden we?

Je komt terecht in een organisatie die actief is in de wereld van ramen en deuren en is de drijvende kracht achter twee sterke merken! Via een uitgebreid franchisenetwerk zijn de merken actief in België, Nederland en Frankrijk. Title: Data Management Analyst
Description:
We are currently looking for a Data Management Analyst who will support the IKO companies' master data accuracy, setup, and maintenance. Ensure data integrity across the business applications, including the ERP system. In this role, the individual is required to possess analytical skills to handle and execute business data requirements.




The Data Management Analyst must understand the value of data integrity to the whole organization, including information data lifecycle management, information modeling, master data management, and data requirements gathering. Work with our various ERP systems like JDE, Mapics, Navision, Handsoft, and Business Central. Knowledge of workflow and invoice automation tools like Bottomline, Datahaven, and Inspyrus is a plus. The individual should interact with the various business and information technology functions.




The Data Management Analyst will join the Global Master Data Management department of IKO Europe NV, based in Antwerp, and will report to the Global Master Data Manager.




WHEN YOU JOIN US YOU WILL;

Analysis

Execute master data setup and configuration in the various ERP systems and any other applications.
Coordinate own master data requests using workflow tools /central mailbox to ensure that data quality meets established standards and service level expectations.
Partner with internal and external customers to ensure data processes and procedures are followed and completed.
Analyze business requests for compliance and accuracy prior to data entry and completion.
Identify, analyze, and resolve Master data discrepancies.
Review and improve Master Data request guidelines to aid current processes to become more effective.
Provide master data support to all IKO business departments as needed.
Collaborate with business teams to understand their needs and provide data-driven recommendations.
Manage and govern master data across ERP systems (Customer, Vendor, Material/Product)
Define and enforce data standards, naming conventions, and validation rules
Ability to work independently and deliver in a fast-paced environment
Escalate to the Global Master Data Manager when required.




Data continuity and process improvement

Monitor the overall health of the data and execute cleansing efforts for all master data. Improved data quality, including duplicate resolution and hierarchy management.
Identify data and process opportunities through audits, metrics, and trends to evaluate, re-design, and implement continuous improvements.
Work under general supervision and independently solve moderately complex issues with minimal supervision, while escalating more complex issues to management.
Understanding of the end-to-end business processes to provide data management and integrity expertise.
Meet current service level agreements agreed upon with the business.
Complete daily/ weekly data integrity tasks.
Document data processes, workflows, and governance policies
Act as a subject matter expert for ERP master data




Collaboration and cross-functional support

Apply data audit and validation methods and procedures to ensure data quality.
Participate and support internal projects requiring data analysis.
Apply Business analysis while gathering data requirements to help with the various in-house projects related to workflow process improvements, plus other projects that may impact the master data side.
Collaborate with Finance, Supply Chain, Sales, and IT teams to understand requirements and provide analytical inputs; aid in resolving data issues.
Ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment.
Support data conversion, integration, and ERP initiatives




OUR IDEAL CANDIDATE;

Minimum of 3 years of experience in master data management
Business degree in Information Systems/ Computer Science/ Supply Chain
Computer proficiency with Excel, Visio, Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
Fluency in French and Dutch is required for effective communication with stakeholders
Utilization of advanced Excel features, such as VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, pivot tables, and data cleanup, to analyze and interpret business data
Proven experience as an MDM Analyst/ ERP Data Analyst
Previous work experience in data governance or a similar role; experience with data governance tools
Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills
Strong communication skills to communicate complex findings
Ability to jump in quickly with minimal training
Ability to document processes and procedures
Ability to troubleshoot data issues
Previous experience with data migration/conversion, data lifecycle, and data quality
Previous experience creating and changing data for vendors, customers, and products




Understanding of ERP master data concepts:

Customer
Vendor
Material/Product
Comfort working with structured data and following processes
Good written communication (tickets, documentation)
Familiarity with data quality checks and validation rules




Nice to have:

BI/reporting tool knowledge/ experience (Power BI, Tableau/ Reports Now)
Experience supporting ERP implementations or data conversions
Knowledge of SQL




WORK AUTHORIZATIONS AND TRAVEL;

Minimal travel (5 days or less annually and no business travel outside the local area)

Title: DATA ANALYST (LIEGE-BELGIUM)
Description:
THE SCOPE

With 30 years of history, today Gaming1 is one of the international leaders in both land-based and online games of chance (casino games, sports betting and poker). Its evolution at the heart of innovation is accompanied by a diversification and specialization of positions, with the creation of new cutting-edge jobs.

YOUR ROLE

Answering business questions on your player journey with rigorous, well-structured analyses, from data extraction to the final recommendation.
Building and maintaining the dashboards and reports (Power BI) that your Area relies on day to day, with attention to accuracy and clarity.
Digging into player behavior — funnels, drop-offs, retention, segmentation — to understand not just what happened, but why.
Contributing to explorations and Proof of Concepts (including AI) alongside more experienced analysts, to test hypotheses and qualify new approaches.
Turning your findings into clear, visual deliverables (insight notes, dashboards) that decision-makers can act on directly.
Working closely with the Head Of, PM, Data Engineers & Data Scientists of your Area, and progressively building that relationship yourself.
Learning the business inside out: the player journey, the products, the operational realities behind the numbers.

Your mindset

You are curious by nature and genuinely want to understand how things work, rather than simply producing the requested output.
You enjoy formulating hypotheses, confronting them with reality, and accepting when facts contradict your initial assumptions.
You ask questions when something doesn't add up, and you are comfortable saying you don't know yet.
You don't just deliver a report; you want to understand the actual friction behind player behavior and its root causes.
You take feedback well and turn it into progress — you want to grow fast, and you know that means being challenged.
You care about the quality and reliability of your work, and you document what you build.
You thrive in a team environment and interact daily with various departments to refine your understanding of business reality.

YOUR PROFILE

Typically, 1 to 3 years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence or a related analytical role — or a strong first experience such as an internship or a significant academic project.
Solid SQL skills: you are comfortable writing joins, aggregations and window functions, and eager to grow towards production-grade queries.
Hands-on experience with a data visualization tool (e.g. Power BI, Tableau) and a willingness to deepen your expertise in semantic modelling and DAX.
Familiarity with data modelling fundamentals (star schema, basic data quality principles) and an appetite for structured, reproducible work.
Some exposure to Python for analytical work (data wrangling, exploratory analysis) is a plus.
An interest in customer or player behavioral data — funnels, retention, segmentation — and in the business questions behind them.
Professional proficiency in English.
A degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science or a related quantitative discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

What We Offer

As well as enjoying a unique experience – centered around our values of Pleasure, Team Spirit, Performance, Boldness and Integrity – alongside 1.600 colleagues worldwide, you'll have the opportunity to contribute to the international development of a fast-growing family company.

Joining Gaming1 means becoming part of a human and entrepreneurial adventure where people are empowered to make an impact, grow and succeed together.

We offer:

the opportunity to work on ambitious international projects within a solid and growing group
a collaborative and high-performing work environment
leadership based on trust, autonomy, talent and shared values
continuous learning and career development opportunities through training and internal mobility
a competitive salary and benefits package aligned with the local market
a hybrid working model, with the possibility to work remotely up to 50% of your working time
an international and collaborative environment where people come first

Je luistert actief naar de behoeften van de klant, analyseert deze én implementeert de oplossingen in onze tooling. Zo zorg je voor concrete inzichten in hun bedrijfsvoering. Je klanten zijn zowel interne stakeholders (CFO, directie van de verschillende business units) als externe klanten die rekenen op doordachte rapportages en BI-oplossingen

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden

  • Uitbouwen en optimaliseren van dashboards en rapportages in Power BI en Microsoft Fabric ter ondersteuning van onze bestaande oplossingen.
  • Analyseren van data en trends, en deze vertalen naar duidelijke conclusies en actievoorstellen ter ondersteuning van strategische beslissingen
  • Opzetten, onderhouden en modelleren van datawarehouses en dataflows.
  • Integreren en structureren van data uit diverse systemen (o.a. Business Central).
  • Vertalen van business requirements naar duidelijke BI-oplossingen.

Je Skills

WAT VERWACHTEN WIJ VAN JOU?

  • Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring als data-engineer of in een gelijkaardige rol.
  • Sterke kennis van geavanceerd Excel-gebruik, inclusief formules, SQL, draaitabellen en gegevensmodellering.
  • Ervaring met PowerBI, Microsoft Fabric en algemene Azure kennis (o.a. Storage Accounts & Key Vaults)
  • Terminologie zoals Datawarehouse, Datalake en Lakehouse zijn niet onbekend voor jou.
  • Vlotte kennis van Nederlands en Engels.

Troeven

WAT KRIJG JE VAN ONS?

Bij VanRoey bieden we medewerkers kansen in een inspirerende werkomgeving. We zijn trots om tot 3x op toe gecertificeerd te zijn als Great Place to Work, waar groei en plezier hand in hand gaan.

Kies je voor een job als Data & Analytics Consultant dan bieden we jou:

  • Persoonlijke & Technische Groei: Toegang tot trainingen, workshops en certificeringen.
  • Werkplezier: Een inspirerende werkomgeving met ruimte voor fun en gezelligheid!
  • Balans: Flexibele werkuren, telewerk en 12 adv-dagen.
  • Beloning: Een competitief loonpakket met extralegale voordelen zoals een bedrijfswagen, gsm-abonnement, laptop en meer.

Title: Analytics Engineer (Northern Belgium)
Description:
DOES THIS SOUND LIKE YOU?

Your passion is data and analytics. You want to create value for our clients by uncovering, organizing, and making sense of data. You understand that it is important to build robust solutions. You feel comfortable operating in the sweet spot between business and engineering.




WHAT YOU WILL DO TO MAKE ORGANIZATIONS DATA-DRIVEN

The Analytics Engineer is the bridge between business and analytics. You understand what data can bring to the organization. With your effective communication skills, you help uncover business needs and how to support them with data, reporting, and visualization. You use software engineering best practices to write production-grade data pipelines, making high-quality data available for creating business value with analytics. You leverage modern tooling to model, test, and document data.

Your efforts enable data democratization by improving the reliability and accessibility of data products. As an Analytics Engineer, you play a vital role in empowering end users to make data-driven decisions.

Check out our website or one of our customer stories to get a more detailed understanding of what we do.

Interested in learning more about how and why the role of Analytics Engineering emerged? You can read this blogpost from one of our Analytics Engineers!




WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Within the Analytics Engineering team, we are looking for like-minded people that we would like to work with. We are not looking for a specific type of professional. We all come from very different cultural and educational backgrounds. We love this diversity, and we built an inclusive culture around it. We do not judge, instead, we care about and support each other. We share a genuine curiosity about what we do, and together we get better at it every day. We look for people with this mindset before anything else. The Analytics Engineer is part of the central data platform team and reports to the Data Platform Lead. The Analytics Engineer works closely with the Data Engineers, the Data Governance Specialist, and the Data Stewards from the domains. During the Foundation and Operationalization phases, the Analytics Engineer temporarily fulfills the steward role for departments that do not yet have their own Data Steward.




Responsibilities and tasks

· Designing and building data transformations that convert raw data from the platform into semantic datasets and data products

· Developing reports, dashboards, and analytical datasets in collaboration with Data Stewards and business users

· Translating content-related questions from the business into technical data products in collaboration with the Data Steward of the relevant domain

· Contributing to the business glossary in Microsoft Purview, particularly regarding the definitions resulting from transformations

· Documenting datasets and data products in a manner accessible to business users

· Performing acceptance tests on data deliveries together with the Data Owner and requester

· Contributing to data quality incidents as described in process 3 of the TOM, particularly regarding reports arising from transformations or data products

· Participating in the agile working method of the team

· Contribute to code reviews and quality assurance of the work of fellow engineers




WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

As an Analytics Engineer, you are the one who converts raw data into something the business can actually work with. You will work in a team of five data specialists and maintain continuous contact with colleagues from the business to understand their information needs and translate them into concrete data products.

Your responsibilities include, among others:

· Contributing ideas regarding architectural coherence and identifying technical debt

· Designing and building data transformations that convert raw data into usable datasets and reports

· Translating business requirements into technical data products in collaboration with the Data Stewards from the domains

· Building reports and analytical datasets that assist in operational and strategic decision-making.

· Temporarily fulfilling a steward role for departments that have not yet appointed their own Data Steward, acting as the bridge between that department and the data platform

· Documenting what you build in a way that is understandable to both fellow engineers and business users

· Working in an agile team where shared quality and delivery come first




THIS IS YOUR DREAM JOB IF…

✅ You love creating value by solving various problems with data, in the most sustainable and robust way.

✅ You are trained as a data analyst, scientist, or engineer but have a deep interest in data modeling and software engineering best practices.

✅ You are a jack-of-all-trades, who wants to become a true authority in the field by learning new skills and trying out the latest data tools.

✅ You have excellent communication skills, are interested in learning about the whole data cycle, can write efficient SQL queries, have hands-on experience with Python, Dbt, and cloud platforms, and you stand out for your expertise in one or more areas of analytics engineering.

✅ You like staying on projects long-term.




THIS IS NOT YOUR DREAM JOB IF…

❌ You always take the academic approach to data and analytics and find it hard to be pragmatic.

❌ You do not enjoy communicating with stakeholders, getting to know the needs of the business, and formulating sustainable solutions.

❌ You do not want to become an authority. You are hesitant to take a proactive approach and bring your ideas forward.

❌ You dislike sharing knowledge by leading trainings, organizing workshops, or writing blog posts.

❌You are not located in Belgium and cannot accommodate the required on-site presence of approximately three days per week.




WHAT IT IS LIKE TO BE A CONSULTANT AT XEBIA DATA

As a consultant at Xebia Data, you will have projects of varying length. Some are 2 weeks, some are 1 year, most are in between. Every project is different, as is every client. We, however, always deliver the best quality possible. It is not always easy, but it is always rewarding. You will have exposure to different companies, different problems, different systems and solutions. You will be surrounded by experts in different fields, and you will learn so many new things in a short time. Xebia Data offers the perfect environment to shine as a data professional.

You will never be alone on this journey. We have all experienced imposter syndrome, had a difficult project, or felt down at times. We know what it takes, we know it is difficult sometimes, and we will be there for you when you need it. We say People First, and we mean it.




Xebia Data offers you great benefits too, of course!

We work in a hybrid model – at client sites, in our own office in Amsterdam Oostenburg, and from home. While flexibility is important, coming to the office is essential for building the close-knit team we are. We value team cohesion, knowledge and personal development, innovation, and fun. We strive for authority in everything we do. At most companies, you'll see similar statements, but at Xebia Data, we back this up with concrete benefits:




Monthly Hackathons

Full-day hackathons on company time. You can choose to work on whatever and with whomever. Want to invite a friend from outside? No problem.

Development Budget

€5,000 per year and 6 days of dedicated development time – it's your obligation to spend it on anything that will make you a better data professional.

Conferences and Speaking

Attending and speaking at relevant conferences doesn't come out of your vacation time.

Knowledge Sharing

Bi-weekly knowledge sharing events with your Xebia colleagues that include dinner.

Sandbox Environments ☁️

Build, test, and experiment with anything you want in our GCP, AWS, and Azure sandbox environments.

A modern office in Eindhoven and Antwerp
Great Community

We're heavily involved in our community by sponsoring, hosting, and organizing events. Have an idea for a meetup we should sponsor? Or want to start a new one? Let's do it!

Physical and Mental Well-being

Great benefits for your physical and mental health, plus free healthy lunches and not-so-healthy drinks/snacks at our offices.

Tech and Mobility Budget

A generous tech budget, plus a monthly mobility budget to spend on leasing a car, leasing the e-bike of your dreams, or getting an NS Business Card.

Unlimited Book Budget

Feed your curiosity and keep learning – order any books you want, on us.

Very Good Pension Plan

We've got your future covered with a solid pension plan.

Fun events and activities like ski trips, BBQs, cooking workshops and more! 👩🏽 🍳




Our core values are people first, quality without compromise, knowledge sharing, and customer intimacy. At Xebia Data, you will find like-minded colleagues who are at the forefront of their field and have the courage to go off the beaten track; they are the people who make organizations move.




Sounds interesting? Let’s talk.

Title: Support Analyst (CapDev)
Company: NATO - Supreme Headquarters Allied Powers Europe (SHAPE)
Description:
Primary Location

Belgium-Mons

Schedule

Full-time

Application Deadline

02-Oct-2026, 11:59:00 PM

Salary (Pay Basis)

5,393.24

Grade

NATO Grade G12


Post Context Supreme Headquarters Allied Powers Europe (SHAPE) provides an integrated Strategic Effects framework, employing a multi-domain and multi-region focus to create a 360-degree approach, with the flexibility to enable, upon direction, a seamless transition from Baseline Activities and Current Operations (BACO) up to the Maximum Level of Effort (MLE). SHAPE supports SACEUR in fulfilling his terms of reference, as directed by the North Atlantic Council.



The J9 Cooperation and Liaison Division provides overarching direction, coordination and advice across ACO on interaction between the Civil and Military entities.

The Support Analyst provides Systems oversight, including the data management, data collection requirements and operationalization of the NATO CIMIC Analysis and Assessment Capability (NCAAC) throughout ACO and in coordination with NATO HQ.


Principal Duties The incumbent's duties are:
Provide ACO’s data specific inputs as contribution to the Capability Development process through all its phases during the NCAAC development, including inputs for the development of NATO’s CIMIC database/area of interest and the articulation of data for the development and update of tools answering ACO’s CIMIC Community of Interest (CoI) dashboards.
Gather and organise data as per the CIMIC analysts requirements and ensure its accuracy and completeness.
Present findings through reports, dashboards, and visual representations to aid decision-making.
Contribute to ensure data integrity, to the protection of sensitive information, in accordance with NATO regulations and directives.
Provide guidance to deliver training for the preparation and the delivery of data using visualisation tools and dashboards in the NCAAC.
Provide the NCAAC with existing data digested from other existing Functional Area Systems in ACO, and from similar initiatives by the Resilience Committee in NATO HQ (IS) and other relevant stakeholders.
Provide CIMIC data to other Functional Area Systems in ACO if required.
Special Requirements and Additional Duties The employee may be required to perform a similar range of duties elsewhere within the organisation at the same grade without there being any change to the contract
The incumbent may be required to undertake TDY assignments both within and without NATO’s boundaries and be willing to work unsocial hours.



The work is normally performed in a Normal NATO office working environment.

Normal Working Conditions apply.

The risk of injury is categorised as No risk / risk might increase when deployed.


Essential Qualifications
Professional/Experience
Minimum of 2 years post-related experience relating to information and data management, analytics or a related field in line with expertise and competencies outlined for this role.
Experience managing large and complex data sets, including both structured (e.g., relational databases, time-series data) and unstructured data (e.g., natural language, sensor data).
Experience with data processing (regular and distributed), data transformation, integration and analysis, including cleaning, and pre-processing of structured and unstructured data for statistical modelling.
Experience with NATO or national Intelligence Requirements Management and Request for Information processes.
Experience with protecting, managing, and storing sensitive and classified information, in accordance with NATO regulations and directives.
Education/Training Higher Secondary education and completed higher vocational training in information technology, economics, statistics, operations research or related discipline leading to a formal technical or professional certification with 3 years function related experience, or Secondary education and completed advanced vocational training in that discipline leading to a professional qualification or professional accreditation with 5 years post related experience.



In case of ambiguity the required job specific experience have priority over the standard education and training levels described here.


Language English - SLP 3333 - (Listening, Speaking, Reading and Writing)
Desirable Qualifications
Professional Experience
Experience in briefing and communicating analytical products with senior military and civilian staff.
Practical experience using big data ecosystems.
Knowledge of NATO software application services e.g.TOPFAS, NCOP, MAVEN Smart System or national equivalent.
Experience designing and delivering training for the use of information systems and processes.
Attributes/Competencies Personal Attributes: The range of personal attributes required for this post are very demanding and exacting, but without them the function will fail. Foremost, an analytical mind is needed to identify and evaluate complex and competing issues and that can develop imaginative yet still pragmatic solutions. Inter-personal skills must also be highly developed. The post holder will be working in an international community where different cultural values and styles exist. The holder will need to be able to work successfully with staff at all levels of the organization, from the lower ranks during the analysis work up to the highest levels when presenting findings and recommendations. This requires tact, judgement and agility. High standards of personal and professional behavior and moral courage are also needed.



Professional Contacts: The incumbent must be comfortable to engage with a range of individuals from across ACO SHAPE and also with the NATO Command Structure and Partner nations. This will be a mixture of Military and Civilian personnel. The individual must have a high level of understanding and be cognizant of sensitivities with an international environment.

REMARKS:

Duration of contract: The successful candidate will fill this post as a Project Linked NATO International Civilian (PLN) with a three-year definite duration contract within the NATO 2030 Agenda. On expiry of this term the PLN will be deleted or absorbed into the ceiling pending approval or will exceptionally be considered for extension.

The salary will be the basic entry-level monthly salary defined by the NATO Grade of the post, which may be augmented by allowances based on the selected staff member’s eligibility, and which is subject to the withholding of approximately 20% for pension and medical insurance contributions.

NATO is committed to diversity and inclusion, and strives to provide equal access to employment, advancement, and retention, independent of gender, age, nationality, ethnic origin, religion or belief, cultural background, sexual orientation, and disability. NATO welcomes applications of nationals from all member Nations.

Building integrity is a key element of NATO’s core tasks. As an employer, NATO values commitment to the principles of integrity, transparency, and accountability in accordance with international norms and practices established for the defence and related security sector. Selected candidates are expected to be role models of integrity, and to promote good governance through ongoing efforts in their work.

Applicants who prove to be competent for the post but who are not successful in this competition may be offered an appointment in another post of a similar nature, which might become vacant in the near future, albeit at the same or lower grade, provided they meet the necessary requirements.

We believe that all people are capable of great things. Because of this, we encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all of the criteria listed within this job description.

HOW TO APPLY FOR A NATO CIVILIAN POST AT SHAPE:

Applications are to be submitted using NATO Talent Acquisition Platform (NTAP) (https://nato.taleo.net/careersection/2/jobsearch.ftl?lang-en). Applications submitted by other means (e.g. mail, e-mail, fax, etc) are not accepted.

More information to be found on these links:

6 Tips for Applying to NATO

Application Process

Shortlisted candidates will be requested to provide original documentary evidence and a set of copies supporting statements in their applications. Appointment is subject to obtaining a NS security clearance and a medical certificate.

Final remarks:


Only nationals from the 32 NATO member states can apply for vacancies at SHAPE.
Applications are automatically acknowledged within one working day after submission. In the absence of an acknowledgement please make sure the submission process is completed, or, re-submit the application.
Qualified redundant staff of the same grade interested in this post should inform this office, via their HR/Personnel Office by not later than vacancy’s closing date.
Candidates’ individual telephone, e-mail or telefax enquiries cannot be dealt with. All candidates will receive an answer indicating the outcome of their application.
NATO will not accept any phase of the recruitment and selection prepared, in whole or in part, by means of generative artificial-intelligence (AI) tools, including and without limitation to chatbots, such as Chat Generative Pre-trained Transformer (Chat GPT), or other language generating tools. NATO reserves the right to screen applications to identify the use of such tools. All applications prepared, in whole or in part, by means of such generative or creative AI applications may be rejected without further consideration at NATO’s sole discretion, and NATO reserves the right to take further steps in such cases as appropriate.
As part of the recruitment process, the organization may review publicly available information to assess potential conflicts of interest, reputational risks, or behaviours inconsistent with the organization’s values.

Title: Data Engineer/Analyst
Description:
About The Company

As a total solution provider of medical devices and pharmaceutical packaging, Nipro Europe Group Companies is continuously committed to improving patient outcomes and quality of life. We are part of a large global network headed by Nipro Corporation Japan, an industry-leading healthcare company with over 38,000 employees worldwide. Our European headquarters in Mechelen, Belgium covers a wide geographical reach (Europe, Africa, India, the Americas) and is home to Nipro Medical EMEA, Nipro PharmaPackaging International, and the Institute for Medical Practice (iMEP) Belgium.

For Nipro Europe Group Companies, we are looking for a Data Analyst/Engineer who is experienced, hands-on, and communicative to join us in our IT & Digitalization team, based in our EMEA headquarters office in Mechelen, Belgium.

About The Role

We are looking for a talented BI analyst/engineer to join our team.

The ideal candidate has extensive experience in setting up data warehouses/data lakes for data analysis and reporting.

As a BI analyst/developer, you will play a crucial role in collecting, analyzing, and interpreting complex datasets to provide valuable insights that support decision-making within our organization.

The BI analyst/engineer will work closely together with the internal team, external partners and business end-users with respect to all data related topics. This also includes data integration tracks in various projects. The analyst likes to collaborate with local and international people and as such is able to understand and speak the business language as well as the technical language.

How You Will Contribute


Design, develop, and maintain data warehouses and data lakes.
Integrate various data sources and ensure the accuracy and integrity of the data.
Develop interactive dashboards and reports to visualize business insights.
Analyze large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities.
Collaborate with different departments to understand their data needs and translate them into actionable solutions.
Document data processes and provide support for data-related queries.
Set up and monitor the necessary governance to bring changes/projects to production in a structured manner.
Provide occasional L3 support and assistance to key users, diagnose and resolve system issues in cooperation with the internal team and external partners.
Optimize the system usage
Manage internal knowledge base, ensuring proper documentation of the system changes according to the change management policy.
Perform all tasks in accordance with ISO and JSOX quality requirements and taking Nipro values into account.


What You Bring To Nipro


Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science or a related field.
At least 5 years of experience as a BI analyst/engineer or in a similar role.
Knowledge of SQL and/or Python.
Experience with Azure, Snowflake, and PowerBI is a plus.
Experience with SAP data is a plus.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to present complex data in an understandable way.
You demonstrate the knowledge and understanding of ITSM processes (Incident management, Request fulfilment, Access Management, etc.)
Language: English is a must, any other language is a plus
You are customer minded.
Hands-on mentality.
You have good organization skills.
You have a proactive and out of the box mindset.
You demonstrate flexibility and mobility to optimize contact with the different business units and entities.


Why you should applys


International work environment: 37 different nationalities
International scope
Work with a purpose: patient, health, society
Home working structurally possible
Autonomy and possibility to take initiative

Title: Data Analytics DBA
Description:
Our client is looking for an experienced data and application specialist to help shape and maintain the organization’s database environment, data flows, and reporting capabilities. In this role, you will work closely with internal stakeholders, users, and external development partners to support data management needs, improve existing tools, and ensure reliable, user-friendly solutions.

Responsibilities

You will take ownership of the full lifecycle of database-related activities, from analysis and development to testing, implementation, support, and reporting. Your work will help ensure that data is accurate, accessible, and effectively used across the organization.


Draft the technical specifications for new database developments and present them to potential suppliers
Coordinate the development and programming of shared databases with external partners
Define procedures for data entry and database usage
Test newly developed databases together with users, analyse results, and propose or implement improvements
Organize meetings and follow-up discussions with partners to monitor progress and decisions
Track project decisions and maintain communication with internal stakeholders and external vendors
Prepare the rollout of shared databases and provide training to key users
Investigate operational or data-related issues and propose suitable IT solutions to improve workflows and information sharing
Analyse user needs, adapt existing databases, and develop proposals to address new requirements
Support users with maintenance of individual databases and with the creation or adjustment of new applications, forms, tables, and reports
Manage database users, data structures, and access rights
Oversee configuration, backups, and overall system security
Create reports and analyses that help users interpret and apply data effectively
Verify the accuracy of data from annual accounts and subsidy files
Compare data from multiple sources, including datacubes
Participate in internal working groups and meetings



Technical Skills

The ideal profile combines strong database expertise with solid analytical and reporting skills. Experience in software or database development is essential, along with the ability to work confidently across data flows and business needs.


Strong knowledge of informatics and software/database development
Solid experience with MS SQL Server
Expert knowledge of JSON, XML, Power BI, and Power Query
Experience with BI tools and reporting
Ability to analyse, troubleshoot, and improve data management processes
Capability to develop, program, and maintain user-friendly and accurate databases
Understanding of data security, access management, and backup procedures
Experience with common and organization-specific software



Profile

We are looking for someone who combines technical depth with a hands-on, solution-oriented mindset. You work independently, communicate clearly, and are comfortable supporting users with varied needs.


Bachelor-level education or equivalent experience
2 to 3 years of relevant professional experience
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Experience identifying user needs and translating them into practical improvements
Ability to work autonomously on data flows while respecting GDPR rules and internal procedures
Willingness to escalate complex issues, licensing questions, budget-related decisions, or difficult user complaints when needed
Experience with reporting and data analysis is required



Practical Information


This is a hybrid assignment, with a requirement to work on site 3 days per week
Language requirements: Dutch or French at native or bilingual level, and English at professional working proficiency

Reference #: INW27563

Title: DATA ANALYST
Description:
At Ayesa Digital, we grow with you.




Every professional in our company is essential. Thanks to their talent, we continue to expand: today, we are a global team of more than 11,000 people working toward a shared mission.




Ayesa Digital is currently participating in high-impact European Union projects designed to address major European challenges and drive science and innovation. These strategic technological initiatives stand out for their international scope and strong commitment to socially oriented results.




We are looking for a Data Analyst to join our international team and contribute to collect and clean data from various sources.




Key Responsibilities




Analyse datasets to identify trends and patterns.
Create interactive dashboards and reports that utilize data storytelling to effectively present findings, with defined refresh cadences and Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for key deliverables.
Collaborate with stakeholders to understand data needs.
Develop and maintain data dashboards and reporting tools that provide intuitive access to key metrics and insights, supported by clear documentation and update schedules.
Perform statistical analysis to support decision-making.
Ensure data accuracy and consistency through the implementation of data quality checks, validation rules, and regular reconciliation processes with source systems.
Conduct exploratory data analysis to uncover insights.
Document methodologies and analysis processes.
Recommend improvements based on data insights.
Partner with Data Engineers on data modelling (e.g., star/snowflake schemas) and contribute to a centralized definitions and metrics catalogue.
Present data-driven insights and create actionable, decision-oriented recommendations tailored for non-technical audiences and stakeholders.
Write complex Structured Query Language (SQL) queries for data extraction and transformation, and optimize them for performance and efficiency.




What We Are Looking For (Requirements):




Knowledge of data analysis and manipulation using SQL, Python, or R to extract, transform, and analyse structured and unstructured datasets.
Experience with data visualization and reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Qlik, Microsoft Fabric) to design interactive dashboards and reports.
Knowledge of statistical analysis methods and tools (e.g., SPSS, R, Python libraries) to support evidence-based insights.
Familiarity with spreadsheet tools, especially Microsoft Excel.
Knowledge of data warehousing concepts and platforms (e.g., star/snowflake schemas, Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, BigQuery) to support scalable reporting
Knowledge of data preparation and transformation tools (e.g., Alteryx, Power Query, dbt) to ensure clean and reliable dataset
Ability to work with large datasets and databases.
Awareness of basic machine learning algorithms (e.g., regression, clustering, classification) to support advanced analytics in collaboration with data scientists.
Knowledge of ETL processes and orchestration tools (e.g., SSIS, Informatica, Talend, Azure Data Factory) to support data pipelines
Knowledge of cloud-based data services (e.g., Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse) to enable scalable and modern analytics.
Knowledge of data quality practices (e.g., validation rules, reconciliation, lineage tracking) to ensure accuracy and consistency of insights.
Knowledge of metadata and cataloguing tools (e.g., Azure Purview, Collibra) to support data governance and discoverability.




One of the following or an equivalent certification:




Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst Associate.
Microsoft Azure Data Engineer Associate
Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate
Fabric Data Engineer Associate.




What We Offer:

Prestigious projects within European institutions.
International, innovative, and multicultural environments.
Continuous support from a team of experts in EU projects.




If you are ambitious, enthusiastic, and seeking a new professional challenge in international projects with real-world impact, this is the place for you!

Bedrijfsinformatie

Voor ons Supply Chain team zoeken we een nauwkeurige en analytisch sterke Master Data Analyst die een sleutelrol speelt in het beheer van product- en artikeldata binnen onze ERP-omgeving.




Taken

Als Master Data Analyst ben je verantwoordelijk voor het beheer, de kwaliteit en de integriteit van masterdata binnen de organisatie.

Je staat onder meer in voor:

Aanmaken en beheren van artikelcodes, stuklijsten (BOM's), kruisreferenties, aliassen en productgegevens in M3.
Verwerken van aanvragen voor nieuwe artikelcodes en productlanceringen.
Correct onderhouden van productbeschrijvingen, kenmerken en datamodellen.
Beheren van productstructuren, tekeningen en technische specificaties.
Uitvoeren van wijzigingsdocumenten en systeemupdates met betrekking tot masterdata.
Controleren van artikelcodes en stuklijsten op volledigheid en nauwkeurigheid.
Identificeren van fouten in stamgegevens en coördineren van correcties.
Opvolgen van KPI's rond datakwaliteit en bijdragen aan verbeterprojecten.
Ondersteunen van initiatieven rond continue verbetering van data- en proceskwaliteit.
Ondersteunen van afdelingen zoals Supply Chain, Customer Service, Productie, Inkoop, Planning en Voorraadbeheer.
Advies geven over correcte datastandaarden, structuren en processen.
Ondersteunen van technische productwijzigingen en productintroducties.
Begeleiden van productuitfaseringen en het verwijderen van artikelcodes binnen M3.
Mee bouwen aan gestandaardiseerde processen en een consistente datawerking binnen de organisatie.
Ondersteunen van ERP-gerelateerde optimalisaties en verbeterprojecten.

Must haves

Bachelor diploma in Informatiemanagement, Bedrijfskunde, Data Management, Supply Chain of een vergelijkbare richting.
Relevante ervaring binnen master data management, productconfiguratie of een andere datagedreven functie.
Ervaring met ERP-systemen.
Sterk analytisch vermogen en oog voor detail.
Uitstekende kennis van Nederlands en Engels.
Gestructureerde en nauwkeurige manier van werken.
Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden.
Zelfstandig kunnen werken én samenwerken in een internationale omgeving.

Kennis van M3 ERP.
Ervaring met BOM-structuren, productconfiguraties of technische data.
Kennis van supply chain processen.
Kennis van Frans of een andere Europese taal.
Ervaring binnen een internationale productie- of industriële omgeving.




Aanbod




Je komt terecht in een internationale toporganisatie waar innovatie, kwaliteit en respect centraal staan.

Brutoloon rond €4.000
Maaltijdcheques (€8/dag)
Groeps- en hospitalisatieverzekering
Ecocheques

Title: Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
Wil jij met data échte impact maken op het onderwijs van morgen?

Als Data Analist help je onze organisatie betere beslissingen nemen door data om te zetten in heldere inzichten. Je werkt met een moderne data stack (SQL, Power BI, Snowflake, ...) en krijgt veel autonomie om end-to-end oplossingen uit te bouwen die ook écht gebruikt worden.

Je komt terecht in een mensgerichte organisatie waar data steeds belangrijker wordt en waar jouw werk zichtbaar bijdraagt aan maatschappelijke impact.




Jouw team

Je wordt onderdeel van het Data & Analytics team, waar je samenwerkt met één andere data-analist in België. Daarnaast heb je regelmatig contact met een groter team van data-analisten en experts in Nederland.

Via kennisdeling en best practices versterk je je expertise en draag je mee bij aan de verdere uitbouw van een datagedreven organisatie. Af en toe werk je ook samen op locatie in Den Bosch.




Wat ga je doen?

Als Data Analist werk je van businessvraag tot bruikbaar inzicht. Je fungeert als brug tussen data en besluitvorming en helpt collega's data beter te begrijpen en te gebruiken.




Concreet betekent dit dat je:

• Businessvragen scherp stelt en vertaalt naar analyses en datavereisten.

• Data verzamelt, transformeert en modelleert uit verschillende bronnen.

• End-to-end oplossingen bouwt met SQL en Snowflake; ervaring met Power BI en dbt is een mooie plus.

• Heldere, actiegerichte dashboards en rapporten ontwikkelt die effectief gebruikt worden.

• Datakwaliteit, governance en betrouwbaarheid mee bewaakt.

• Inzichten en aanbevelingen duidelijk communiceert naar zowel technische als niet-technische stakeholders.

• Business teams ondersteunt in projecten en besluitvorming.

• Meebouwt aan de verdere professionalisering van processen, data-infrastructuur en het dataplatform.

• Data literacy binnen de organisatie versterkt via begeleiding, workshops of kennisdeling.




Wie zoeken wij?

Je hoeft niet alles al perfect te beheersen; leergierigheid en analytisch denkvermogen zijn minstens zo belangrijk.




• Je hebt een bachelor diploma of gelijkwaardige ervaring.

• Je hebt 2 tot 4 jaar ervaring in data-analyse, BI of insights.

• Je werkt vlot met SQL en BI-tools.

• Ervaring met dbt, Power BI en Snowflake is een sterke troef, of je wil je hierin snel verdiepen.

• Kennis van Python is een plus.

• Je kan complexe informatie helder uitleggen aan verschillende doelgroepen.

• Je werkt gestructureerd, denkt analytisch en neemt ownership.

• Je bent een teamspeler die kennis deelt en graag bijleert.

• Je volgt trends in data, AI en analytics en denkt mee over toepassingen.

• Je kan professioneel communiceren in het Frans of bent bereid dit verder te versterken.




Wat mag je van ons verwachten?

• Een mensgerichte cultuur met veel aandacht voor welzijn en werkgeluk.

• Een betekenisvolle job met maatschappelijke impact.

• Werken binnen een sterke internationale groep (Sanoma).

• Ruimte om te groeien, leren en initiatief te nemen.

• Samenwerking met ervaren data-professionals in België en Nederland.

• Een competitief loon aangevuld met extralegale voordelen.

• Hybride werken met meerdere dagen per week thuiswerk.

• Moderne kantoren in Wommelgem en Mont-Saint-Guibert, volledig uitgerust voor hybride samenwerking.
