Title: Revenue Analytics Engineer
Description:
Context & Impact

As Lansweeper scales its SaaS business across new products and markets, revenue analytics has become a critical function for steering executive and board-level decisions. This role exists to bring structure, trust, and clarity to how Lansweeper measures and understands its revenue.

You will be the dedicated Revenue Analytics Engineer within a 10-person Data & Analytics team — the first hire focused entirely on revenue — reporting directly to the Data Platform Manager. Your work will directly shape how C-level leaders and the board understand growth, and how sales and finance teams plan and act.

In the near term, your goals are to establish a single source of truth for revenue KPIs, build board-ready reporting, and deliver forecasting models that drive go-to-market decisions.

Challenge

The Main Challenges You'll Face Are


Speed vs. complexity: The sales organization moves fast and needs reliable revenue facts quickly — but revenue data is sourced from multiple systems (CRM, billing, ERP) with historic complexity from acquisitions and system migrations, and data quality that varies over time.
Keeping up with a changing business:** As Lansweeper's product and market evolve, sales and marketing allocation must follow. You'll need to continuously adapt revenue models to reflect new business processes and priorities.
Being the first and only:** You are the sole analytics engineer focused on revenue. You'll need to build foundations from scratch, establish trust in the numbers, and earn your seat at the table with finance and executive stakeholders — all at the same time.


Key Responsibilities


Build, maintain, and improve revenue data models** that power executive-level reporting and board-ready metrics across ARR, MRR, churn, expansion, contraction, and renewal cycles
Reconcile revenue data across systems of record** — CRM, billing, and ERP — and establish a single, trusted source of truth for financial KPIs
Design and deliver dashboards and reports** that translate complex revenue data into clear, actionable insights for sales, finance, and leadership
Partner with sales operations and finance** to understand evolving business processes and reflect them accurately in revenue analytics models
Develop and maintain forecasting models** for key revenue metrics to support go-to-market planning and strategic decision-making
Investigate and explain trends, anomalies, and shifts** in revenue data, linking them back to underlying sales and finance drivers
Proactively improve data quality and integrity** across revenue-related data pipelines to ensure consistent, reliable reporting


Key Requirements

Hard Skills


Financial metrics reporting — solid understanding of how revenue, bookings, churn, ARR, MRR, expansion, contraction, and renewal KPIs are defined and measured in a SaaS context
Strong SQL skills — ability to write, optimize, and debug complex queries against large datasets
Systems reconciliation — hands-on experience resolving data mismatches between CRM, billing, and finance systems to produce a reliable single source of truth
Data modelling — familiarity with best practices such as dimensional modelling and slowly changing dimensions; experience with Snowflake and dbt is a strong plus
Dashboard and reporting delivery— experience building clear, business-facing reports; experience with **Power BI** is a strong plus


Soft Skills


Analytical storytelling — you translate data into business narratives that support decisions, not just numbers on a screen
Stakeholder collaboration— you work confidently with finance, sales ops, and executive audiences, adapting your communication to each
Ownership mindset — you take initiative, work independently, and drive outcomes without waiting to be directed


AI-Specific Skills

Lansweeper is an AI-native company. In this role, AI fluency is a hard requirement — not a nice-to-have.

You are expected to use AI tooling as a standard part of your day-to-day workflow: this includes AI-assisted SQL generation and debugging, using AI to accelerate data modelling and anomaly investigation, and leveraging AI features within your analytics stack (such as Snowflake Cortex or dbt-integrated tooling). You should be comfortable prompting AI tools effectively, evaluating their outputs critically, and integrating AI into repeatable workflows — from data pipeline development to generating draft narrative summaries for executive reporting. General AI fluency across platforms such as ChatGPT or Copilot is expected.

Team Info

You'll join the Insights & Intelligence team, part of the broader Data & Analytics function at Lansweeper. The team has 10 people and is led by the **Data Platform Manager**, who you will report to directly. You will work closely with sales operations, finance, and data engineers across the organization.

As the **only analytics engineer focused on revenue**, you will own this domain end-to-end — a rare opportunity to define how a growing SaaS company understands and steers its revenue.

The team is based across Ghent, Belgium and Alicante, Spain, with a hybrid working model at both locations.

Our Offer

Salary

See Pay Transparency section below.

Benefits — Belgium


Meal vouchers
Eco vouchers
Hospitalisation insurance
Group insurance
Company car or mobility budget
Phone plan
Internet allowance


Benefits — Spain


Health insurance
Meal allowance
Flexible remuneration plan


What Else You Get


A high-impact, high-autonomy role at the intersection of data, finance, and go-to-market strategy
Hybrid working from either **Ghent, Belgium or Alicante, Spain** — flexibility built in by design
A pragmatic, collaborative data team that values ownership and real-world impact over process for process's sake
The opportunity to **build the revenue analytics function from the ground up** in a scaling SaaS company
A front-row seat to C-level and board decision-making, with your work directly influencing strategic direction


About Lansweeper

Lansweeper is the AI Cyber Asset Intelligence platform helping IT and Security teams gain full visibility, reduce cyber risk, and scale automation with confidence.

In today's complex IT, OT, cloud, and IoT environments, fragmented asset data slows decisions and increases risk. We transform raw asset data into a continuously validated, trusted source of truth — so teams can move faster and act with certainty.

With Lansweeper, Organizations Can

See – Truly complete visibility across hybrid environments

Know– Enriched asset intelligence with lifecycle and risk context

Act – Automate workflows, coordinate remediation, and enforce policy at scale

From universal asset discovery to AI-powered intelligence, we provide the shared foundation modern IT Operations, Cybersecurity, and Digital Transformation teams rely on.

Our Culture — Built On Four Core Values


One Team – United across boundaries
We Care – Customers and people at the centre
We Grow – Learning, sharing, improving
We Deliver – Focusing on what truly matters


Pay Transparency

At Lansweeper, every role is assigned to a level defined by three things: the expertise it requires, the complexity it involves, and the scope of impact it carries.

Each level maps to a salary band based on salary benchmarks from the Software/SaaS industry of your country, so your pay reflects what the market pays for comparable roles.

The gross salary range for this role is €107,000 – €174,000 (EUR) (Belgium) or €75,000 – €123,000 (EUR) (Spain) (based on full-time employment).

Where you land within that range depends on the expertise you bring, the complexity you have navigated, the scope of impact you have owned, and your track record of delivering results in comparable roles — the same criteria applied consistently to every candidate.

We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, regardless of gender, religion, ethnic origin, age, sexual orientation, or disability.

How AI Is Used During The Hiring Process

We use AI to support and not replace during the hiring process. HR decisions are made by our talent acquisition team. You can request more info at any time via [email protected]

Diversity Statement

It is Lansweeper's policy to provide equal employment opportunity to all applicants and employees.

Lansweeper disapproves of, and will not tolerate, unlawful discrimination against any applicant or employee because of race, color, national origin or ancestry, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), gender identity, age, religion, disability, family care status, veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, or any other basis protected by local, state, or federal laws.

Description:
Cegeka’s afdeling Flanders Digital bouwt samen met de Vlaamse Overheid aan moderne dataplatformen op basis van o.a. Microsoft Fabric. Deze platformen vormen de basis voor datagedreven beleid rond thema’s zoals wonen en energie. We kijken momenteel uit naar een Data Platform Analyst die ervoor zal zorgen dat deze platformen effectief waarde opleveren voor de organisatie. Je werkt op het snijvlak van gebruikers, beleid en data engineering in een productgedreven datateam.


Als brug tussen business en technologie ben je verantwoordelijk voor het vertalen van businessvragen naar concrete oplossingen op het dataplatform, en waak je erover dat deze oplossingen effectief gebruikt worden en waarde leveren.
Je analyseert vragen van business en beleidsgebruikers en je vertaalt deze noden naar duidelijke requirements voor het dataplatformteam.
Je werkt nauw samen met data engineers en BI profielen binnen een Microsoft Fabric omgeving.
Je valideert of de opgeleverde oplossingen correct en bruikbaar zijn (testing, acceptatie).
Je communiceert resultaten en inzichten naar stakeholders en je begeleidt hen in het gebruik.
Je detecteert proactief opportuniteiten waar data extra waarde kan creëren.
Je krijgt de ruimte om ownership te nemen over use cases, stakeholders mee te nemen en impact te realiseren op schaal van Vlaanderen.


Wat breng jij mee?


Je hebt ervaring in een rol op het snijvlak van business en data (functioneel analist, data analyst, product analyst, …).
Je kan businessvragen structureren en vertalen naar technische requirements.
Je begrijpt hoe dataplatformen werken (data pipelines, modellering, rapportering).
Je hebt ervaring met SQL en/ of data visualisatie (Power BI).
Je bent bekend met testing en validatie van data-oplossingen.
Je bent sterk in communicatie en stakeholder management.
Ervaring met Microsoft Fabric, Azure of gelijkaardige platformen (bv. Databricks, Synapse, Snowflake, Cloudera) is een pluspunt.
Deed je al ervaring op in een overheidscontext of werkte je al met beleidsdata? Ook dat is voor deze functie een pluspunt.
Je werkt 1 dag/ week vanuit het Cegeka-kantoor in Leuven, en 1 dag/ week ben je onsite bij de klant in Brussel. Op de overige dagen is er de mogelijkheid tot thuiswerk.


Wat hebben wij jou te bieden?


Je komt terecht bij een echte Top Employer
Cegeka bewijst jaar na jaar in het Whitelane Research dat we een betrouwbare en toonaangevende partner zijn op vlak van IT-dienstverlening, met een eerste plaats in 2026 voor Security Services (vierde jaar op rij), een gedeelde tweede plaats voor Cloud & Infrastructure Services en Network & Connectivity
We vragen heel wat (talenten) van jou. Gelukkig krijg je er ook heel wat voor terug! Competenties en karakter zijn voor ons essentieel, naast ervaring en ambities. Cegeka investeert voortdurend in talent management opdat alle medewerkers hun potentieel kunnen realiseren
Wij hanteren een framework met het oog op eerlijke verloning, waarbij medewerkers worden verloond op basis van hun functie, ervaring en prestaties, onafhankelijk van gender of andere niet-werkgerelateerde kenmerken. Een elektrische wagen met laadpas of een mobiliteitsbudget, maaltijdcheques, ecocheques, een interessante groeps- en hospitalisatieverzekering, een gsm-abonnement, een forfaitaire onkostenvergoeding, een krachtige laptop en de mogelijkheid om je salarispakket een eigen accent te geven dankzij ons Flex Reward Plan
Flexibele werkuren én een mooie work/life balans
Een top team: waarin nieuwe frisse ideeën en initiatieven steeds welkom zijn! Team-events, happy hours en een steeds legendarisch bedrijfsfeest horen daar ook bij
Continu bijleren: knowledge sharing meetings, deelname aan conferenties en externe opleidingen. Kennisdeling en bijleren staan centraal! Afhankelijk van je eigen interesses en initiatieven, biedt Cegeka verschillende horizontale en verticale carrièrepaden
We hechten waarde aan duurzaamheid door CO2-neutraliteit na te streven met de elektrificatie van ons wagenpark en een milieuvriendelijk datacenter. We ontwikkelen innovatieve oplossingen met een positieve impact op milieu, mens en maatschappij, en streven naar een inclusieve en diverse werkomgeving waarin iedereen gewaardeerd en gehoord wordt.


Onze voordelen

Marktconform salaris met aantrekkelijke extralegale voordelen.

Continuous learning via hackathons, leesgroepen, events,...

Flexibele werktijden voor een betere balans tussen werk en privé.

Carrièregroei met horizontale en verticale ontwikkelpaden.

Hybride werkmodel dat efficiënt kantoor- en thuiswerk combineert.

Persoonlijke begeleiding door managers, coaches en sparringpartners.

ESG: lagere emissies, bevorderen van inclusie en duurzaamheid in IT.

Cegeka draagt met trots het Top Employer-certificaat.

Teamevenementen, happy hours, sport en grandioos bedrijfsfeest.

Title: Data analyst
Description:
About The Role

As a Data Analyst, you will help organizations turn complex data into meaningful insights and practical business solutions. You will work at the intersection of data, technology and business, supporting clients in improving data foundations, processes and decision-making.

In this role, you will contribute to data-driven transformation initiatives, working closely with business stakeholders, data teams and technology teams. You will combine hands-on data preparation and analysis with project management and a strong understanding of business needs.

What you will do

Data Analysis & Preparation


Collect, combine and prepare data from multiple sources for analysis and reporting.
Design, maintain and optimize data flows and transformation processes.
Analyze datasets to identify trends, patterns, anomalies and opportunities.
Translate business questions into data-driven analyses and practical recommendations.
Investigate data quality issues and work with data owners and providers to resolve them.
Develop dashboards, visualizations and analytical outputs to support business decision-making.


Data & Process Transformation


Analyze existing data processes and identify opportunities for improvement and automation.
Contribute to the redesign and optimization of data flows and analytical processes.
Support data migration and transformation initiatives, including the transition to new data environments and tools.
Challenge existing ways of working and propose innovative and scalable solutions.
Help establish robust and sustainable data foundations.


Project & Stakeholder Management


Manage and coordinate data-related activities and project deliverables.
Work closely with business users, data providers, IT teams and other stakeholders across different functions and locations.
Translate business and operational requirements into clear data solutions.
Plan, monitor and communicate progress, risks and dependencies.
Present findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.


Your profile


3–5 years of experience in data analytics, business analysis or data-related transformation projects.
Experience in project management or project delivery is required.
Hands-on experience with Dataiku is required.
Knowledge of Alteryx is required.
Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau is a strong plus.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a structured and detail-oriented approach.
Comfortable working with multiple data sources, data preparation and ETL/data transformation processes.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Curious, proactive and eager to understand new business domains and processes.
A Master's degree in a quantitative, technical or analytical field is preferred, but equivalent practical experience is also valued.
Fluent in English and French; Dutch is a strong plus.


The way we work

This is a hybrid consulting role with regular on-site work at the client. You will work from the client's premises on a regular basis to collaborate with stakeholders, understand business needs and ensure effective delivery.

Why Join Capco?


Work on data, analytics and transformation initiatives at leading financial institutions.
Join a global consultancy with an entrepreneurial culture and a strong focus on innovation and impact.
Collaborate with experts across business, data, technology and transformation.
Access continuous learning, certifications and career development opportunities.
Enjoy a flexible hybrid working model, with regular client-site collaboration, and a people-first environment.
Benefit from an attractive remuneration package reflecting your experience, including a company car or green mobility budget, net allowances, end-of-year bonus, health insurance, meal vouchers, laptop, and mobile phone with subscription.


Ready to make an impact? Apply now and join Capco.

Title: Data Analyst Confirmé (H/F)
Description:
Vous souhaitez rejoindre une entreprise qui place l’humain au cœur de ses préoccupations ? On vous attend chez Extia !

Société de conseil spécialisée dans les métiers de l’IT et du digital, Extia privilégie depuis sa création en 2007 une approche qui allie performance et bien-être au travail. Une vision de l’entreprise partagée aujourd’hui par plus de 2 500 Extiens en France et à l'international et récompensée par le label Great Place to Work® depuis 15 ans dont 10 ans sur le podium et 3 années consécutives à la première place du palmarès !

Nous croyons en l'égalité des chances et nous offrons à chaque candidat la possibilité de révéler son potentiel, sans distinction et de quelque nature qu'elle soit. Chez Extia, c’est « D’abord qui, ensuite quoi » alors, allons-y !


Créatif, vous avez toujours une solution inédite mais adéquate à proposer
Curieux, poser des questions est votre seconde nature
Analytique, vous avez une âme d’enquêteur et les énigmes n’ont aucun secret pour vous


Description Du Poste

Vous serez intégré(e) dans une équipe de consultants innovants et motivés, composée de Business Analysts, Data Scientists et Data Engineers spécialisés sur les problématiques Data Analytics. À ce titre, vous interviendrez de façon opérationnelle sur des missions de conseil autour des sujets de transformation Data Analytics, de retraitement et modélisation de données et de représentation visuelle de la donnée pour adresser des problématiques métiers.

Vous serez notamment en charge de :


Comprendre les problématiques métier,
Collecter et traiter les données en vue de l'analyse, incluant notamment la création de variables agrégées et complémentaires aux données brutes,
Automatiser et d’industrialiser les retraitements effectués sur les données,
Représenter les résultats dans un outil de restitution visuelle de façon ergonomique et intuitive,
Restituer les analyses au client notamment pas la création d’indicateurs pertinents pour les questions stratégiques des entreprises


PROFIL RECHERCHE

Diplômé d'une école d'ingénieurs ou équivalent (Bac +5), vous justifiez d’a minima 2 ans d’expérience réussis en tant que data analyst :


Vous possédez une bonne connaissance des outils et méthodologies de Data Analytics, incluant notamment des bases techniques (modèles de données, langage SQL, …) mais également méthodologiques,
Vous possédez une connaissance approfondie d'Excel et maitrisez les langages statistiques tels que R, Python ou SAS,
Une connaissance d'un logiciel ou langage dédié à la Data Visualization (Tableau, Qliksense ou Qlickview, Microsoft Power BI…) ainsi que des compétences en automatisation (VBA par exemple) seraient un plus.


PROCESSUS DE RECRUTEMENT


Échangez avec un ou une chargée de recrutement pour un premier contact téléphonique
Rencontrez un ou une Ingénieure d’Affaires (Business Manager) sur vos souhaits d’évolution
Approfondissez avec nos responsables et directeurs d’agence pour connaître la vision de l'agence


Selon votre profil, des tests ou entretiens techniques pourront vous être demandés. Tout au long du processus, vous pourrez échanger avec nos consultants pour en savoir + sur leur quotidien chez nous !

PACKAGE SALARIAL

Chez Extia Belgique IT, la transparence fait partie intégrante de l'expérience positive, voici un aperçu des éléments de package salarial dont peuvent profiter nos collaborateurs, sous réserve d'éligibilité

👛 Voiture de société ou budget mobilité ✨ Chèques repas & Ecocheque 🎁 Assurance groupe 🎉 Frais de représentation 📈 Plan cafétéria / Flex Income Plan 🚀 Primes d'apport d'affaire, de cooptation et de formation 🌍 20 jours de congés légaux + 12 jours de récupération

Ces informations sont communiquées à titre indicatif et seront abordées plus en détails lors du processus de recrutement.

LES PETITS PLUS

🎉 250 événements par an pour rencontrer tes collègues et des locaux feel good 📢 Des formations, conférences et une plateforme d'e-learning avec LinkedIn pour monter en compétences #greatplacetolearn 👩‍ Des Communautés Métiers et du Mentorat pour partager son expertise et en apprendre sur de nombreux sujets #greatplacetoshare 🕹️ Une communauté de e-sport : Extia Gaming ! #greatplacetoplay 🌏 Envie d’évoluer ? Grâce à notre politique de mobilité interne, explorez de nouvelles opportunités en Belgique ou dans l’un de nos 7 autres pays !

Title: Data Analyst – Energy Scenarios & Market Modelling
Description:
Our client is a leading European Transmission System Operator (TSO) responsible for ensuring a reliable, sustainable and secure electricity supply. Within the organisation, the Scenarios, Market & Adequacy Analysis team is responsible for conducting long-term security of supply studies, energy vision studies and cost-benefit analyses for future Grid developments. These studies rely on advanced electricity market modelling and simulation tools to assess future electricity demand, generation capacity and overall system adequacy.

As a Data Analyst, you will support the SMA team in developing future energy scenarios and the modelling frameworks used to study Belgium's and Europe's future electricity system.

This is a highly analytical role combining data analysis, programming and energy market expertise. You'll help build and validate datasets, develop analytical tools, improve data processes and support electricity market simulations used to plan the energy transition.

The client is looking for someone who is both an "energy geek" and a "data geek"—someone who enjoys working with data but is equally interested in understanding how the future electricity system will evolve.

Your responsibilities


Support the development of future energy scenarios for Belgium and Europe.
Build scenarios covering future electricity demand, electric vehicles (Ev), heat pumps (HP), industrial demand, renewable energy sources (RES), thermal generation, flexibility and Storage.
Collect, consolidate and validate large volumes of historical and projected energy data from multiple sources.
Gather projection data from European countries and critically assess whether assumptions are realistic and aligned with defined energy scenarios.
Develop, improve and maintain data collection, data management and scenario-building processes.
Create and maintain datasets used by electricity market modelling tools.
Support model building and perform quality checks on datasets and models.
Assess the impact of modelling assumptions, including demand, renewable production, flexibility and Storage.
Develop and improve tools in Python, R, Excel and VBA.
Create visualisations and analyse simulation outputs using tools such as Power BI, R or QGIS.
Analyse algorithm results, identify trends and support interpretation of simulation outcomes.
Support data engineering activities and interfaces between different tools and systems.
Contribute to improving the team's analytical tools and overall way of working.


What we're looking for


Minimum 3 years of relevant experience (medior level).
Strong programming skills in Python or R (experience with both is a plus).
Strong Excel skills.
Experience with data analysis, data mining, data gathering, processing and visualization.
Knowledge of, or a strong interest in, the Belgian and European energy market.
Genuine interest in the energy transition and future energy systems.
Ability to critically challenge data, assumptions and projections rather than simply processing them.
Analytical, proactive and innovative mindset.
Able to work independently as well as collaboratively.
Fluent in Dutch and/or French, with good English.


Nice to have:


VBA.
Experience with ANTARES or another electricity market simulation/economic dispatch tool.
Experience with electricity market simulations.
Experience with Power BI and/or QGIS.
Data engineering experience.


Technical environment:


Python
R
Excel
VBA
Power BI
QGIS
ANTARES (nice to have)

Within the organisation, the Scenarios, Market & Adequacy Analysis team is responsible for conducting long-term security of supply studies, energy vision studies and cost-benefit analyses for future Grid developments. These studies rely on advanced electricity market modelling and simulation tools to assess future electricity demand, generation capacity and overall system adequacy.

As a Data Analyst, you will support the SMA team in developing future energy scenarios and the modelling frameworks used to study Belgium's and Europe's future electricity system.

This is a highly analytical role combining data analysis, programming and energy market expertise. You'll help build and validate datasets, develop analytical tools, improve data processes and support electricity market simulations used to plan the energy transition.

The client is looking for someone who is both an "energy geek" and a "data geek"—someone who enjoys working with data but is equally interested in understanding how the future electricity system will evolve.

Your responsibilities

  • Support the development of future energy scenarios for Belgium and Europe.
  • Build scenarios covering future electricity demand, electric vehicles (Ev), heat pumps (HP), industrial demand, renewable energy sources (RES), thermal generation, flexibility and Storage.

Title: Data Analyst Récolte de Fonds
Description:
Contribuez à une récolte de fonds plus performante grâce à la puissance des données : rejoignez la Croix-Rouge de Belgique et soutenez, par vos analyses, les missions menées auprès des personnes les plus vulnérables.




La Croix-Rouge de Belgique agit chaque jour pour préparer, secourir et accompagner toute personne en situation de vulnérabilité à surmonter les crises individuelles et collectives, grâce à la mobilisation citoyenne dans des actions de proximité, efficaces, pertinentes et pérennes.

Guidés par nos valeurs et les 7 principes fondamentaux, nous déployons nos actions dans 4 domaines d’activités principaux :

Santé et secours
Précarité et solidarité
Migration et inclusion
Gestion de crise




Le département Marketing et Récolte de Fonds a pour mission de mobiliser les ressources financières nécessaires à la réalisation des missions de la Croix-Rouge de Belgique, en développant des relations durables avec les particuliers, les entreprises et les partenaires qui soutiennent notre action.




Fonction :




En tant que Data Analyst Récolte de Fonds, vous mettez les données au service de la performance et de l’impactdes activités de fundraising. Vous exploitez, analysez et valorisez les données afin d’éclairer les décisions opérationnelles et stratégiques, d’optimiser les campagnes de collecte et de renforcer la connaissance des donateurs.

Vous rejoignez l’organisation à un moment clé, marqué par le déploiement de Salesforce comme nouveau CRM. Cette transformation représente une opportunité majeure pour structurer durablement la gestion des données et développer une culture davantage orientée vers l’analyse et la prise de décision basée sur les données.

Vous travaillez sous la responsabilité de la Responsable Marketing et Récolte de Fonds.




Plus précisément, vos responsabilités seront de :

Exploiter les données du CRM, de Qlik Sense et des autres sources afin de produire et valoriser les analyses et indicateurs nécessaires au pilotage de la récolte de fonds.
Analyser les performances des campagnes, des segments de donateurs et des canaux de collecte (acquisition, fidélisation, conversion, ROI…) pour identifier des leviers d'amélioration et de croissance, et soutenir les décisions opérationnelles et stratégiques.
Être force de proposition dans l’exploitation avancée des données (segmentation, scoring, analyses prédictives, IA…)
Développer et maintenir des tableaux de bord et rapports dans Salesforce et Qlik Sense.
Former les utilisateurs de l'équipe récolte de fonds à l'usage des indicateurs, tableaux de bord et rapports, et documenter les procédures associées.
Être le référent Salesforce pour l'équipe récolte de fonds au quotidien (sélections, segmentations, rapports…), en s'appuyant sur le Product Owner CRM si besoin.
Veiller à la cohérence et à la fiabilité analytique des données utilisées par l’équipe de récolte de fonds et au respect des règles de conservation définies.
Veiller au respect des règles de protection des données personnelles (RGPD) dans l'exploitation et l'analyse des données donateurs.
Remonter au Product Owner CRM les besoins d'évolution du CRM identifiés par l'équipe récolte de fonds en vue de leur implémentation technique.




Profil :

Vous disposez d’une expérience professionnelle d’au moins 3 ans en analyse de données, idéalement acquise dans un environnement de fundraising, de marketing relationnel ou de gestion de la relation client à grande échelle.
Vous maîtrisez les outils de Business Intelligence et d’analyse de données, et avez une expérience confirmée dans la conception de tableaux de bord, le suivi d’indicateurs de performance et l’aide à la décision.
Vous possédezune bonne connaissance d’un CRM tel que Salesforce, HubSpot, Dynamics ou équivalent. Une expérience de Salesforce constitue un atout important.
Vous comprenez les modèles de données et leur construction, notamment via SQL, Qlik Sense ou un outil décisionnel similaire. La maîtrise de Qlik Sense est un avantage.
Vous êtes capable de traduire les besoins métier en analyses concrètes et en solutions opérationnelles, tout en anticipant les attentes des utilisateurs.
Vous faites preuve d’excellentes capacités de communication et savez rendre accessibles des informations ou analyses complexes à des publics variés.
Votre esprit analytique, votre rigueur et votre orientation résultats vous permettent de transformer les données en leviers d’action et de performance.
Vous faites preuve de curiosité et d’un réel intérêt pour l’innovation et les approches analytiques avancées telles que le scoring, les analyses prédictives et l’intelligence artificielle.
Vous combinez autonomie et esprit de collaboration dans la réalisation de vos missions.
Vous maîtrisez le français ; la connaissance de l’anglais constitue un atout.
Vous adhérez aux missions, aux valeurs et à la stratégie de la Croix-Rouge de Belgique.




Modalités du contrat :




Un contrat à durée indéterminée à temps plein et basé à Namur centre (gare) ;

Une rémunération barémique en lien avec votre expérience :

Un package d’avantage extra-légaux composé de :

Chèques repas
Une assurance groupe et une assurance vie privée
L’accès à des tarifs avantageux pour l’assurance hospitalisation
La prise en charge à 100 % des frais de transports en commun domicile-travail et une intervention pour l’utilisation d’un véhicule privé
3 jours de congé supplémentaires aux congés légaux dès la première année,et 4 de plus l’annéesuivante
La possibilité de télétravailler 2 jours par semaine, avec l’indemnité correspondante, après une période d’écolage

Vous avez également la possibilité de vous former.




Ce job est fait pour vous ? Expliquez-nous pourquoi et envoyez-nous votre curriculum vitae et lettre de motivation via la page jobs de notre site internet Data Analyst - Récolte de Fonds - Accueil

Nous sommes impatients de vous connaître !

Title: Data Specialist
Description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.

If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.

Skills And Competencies


Strong ability to interpret, analyse, and validate complex ownership and entity relationship data
High attention to detail with a strong commitment to data accuracy, integrity, and quality control
Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to respond clearly to client enquiries
Strong organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
Problem-solving mindset with a proactive approach to process improvement and operational efficiency
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with internal and external stakeholders
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications
Knowledge of SQL, Databricks, Python, or Power BI is considered an asset
Strong proficiency in English, both written and spoken, is required. Professional fluency in Polish, Turkish, or Arabic is a plus
Interest in emerging technologies and willingness to learn how AI-enabled tools can enhance data quality, research capabilities, and operational efficiency


Education


Bachelor's degree (Bachelor Universitaire/Hogeschool) or Master's degree in Economics, Finance, Statistics, Data Analytics, Computer Science, or a related discipline
Equivalent experience and qualifications will also be considered
Entry-level candidates are welcome to apply


Responsibilities

This role is responsible for managing, enriching, and validating relationship data to ensure the accuracy, consistency, and reliability of information delivered to internal and external clients.


Maintain and enhance relationship data within Moody's relationship data platform using automated feeds, validation workflows, AI-assisted tools, and expert data analysis
Operate control mechanisms and matching processes to ensure data quality and integrity
Respond to client requests and enquiries, providing timely, clear, and effective data support
Support internal and external clients in accessing, understanding, and using relationship and entity data
Deliver weekly updates on relationships, legal entities, and complex corporate relationship structures
Continuously review and improve processes and procedures to increase efficiency, speed, and accuracy of data updates
Contribute to the expansion of existing data offerings by researching new data sources and supporting the integration of additional data elements
Produce and maintain high-quality documentation, including internal procedures, data definitions, methodologies, and FAQs
Identify opportunities to leverage emerging technologies, including AI-enabled solutions, to improve data management processes and operational effectiveness
Collaborate with colleagues and stakeholders to support broader data and client service objectives


About The Team

The team is responsible for delivering high-quality ownership and entity relationship data to a global client base. Working at the intersection of data, research, client support, and technology, the team plays a critical role in ensuring transparency, accuracy, and trust in complex relationship structures. Through a combination of expert analysis, data-driven processes, and AI-enabled tools, the team continuously improves data coverage, quality, and operational efficiency. Team members are encouraged to explore innovative technologies and contribute to the ongoing evolution of data management, client service, and analytical capabilities in a rapidly changing environment.

Moody’s is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law.

Candidates for Moody's Corporation may be asked to disclose securities holdings pursuant to Moody’s Policy for Securities Trading and the requirements of the position. Employment is contingent upon compliance with the Policy, including remediation of positions in those holdings as necessary.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
As a Data Scientist at Cascador/moveUP, you will help turn health data into actionable insights for healthcare providers and life sciences companies.

You will work across data engineering, clinical analytics and artificial intelligence. Depending on your experience, you may build data pipelines, analyse clinical datasets, develop statistical or predictive models, or explore practical AI applications in healthcare.

This is a hands-on role for someone who takes ownership, works independently and enjoys solving complex problems together with Product, Clinical and Engineering teams.




Job requirements

What you will do

Develop analyses, statistical models and predictive models based on clinical and health data.
Build and maintain data pipelines and data processing workflows.
Clean, validate and quality-control sensitive healthcare datasets.
Translate analytical results into clear insights for internal teams and external clients.
Collaborate with Product and Engineering to integrate data solutions into our platform.
Explore responsible and valuable applications of AI in healthcare.
Contribute to data quality, privacy and GDPR compliance.
Communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Take ownership of workstreams and proactively move projects forward.




About you

You are a curious, analytically strong data professional with a hands-on mindset. You are comfortable working independently, making decisions and taking responsibility for delivering high-quality work.

You have a genuine interest in AI. You follow how the field is evolving, experiment thoughtfully and are curious about where AI can create real value in healthcare.

You are also able to explain complex topics clearly, write structured reports and collaborate with colleagues from different backgrounds.




Ideally, you bring

Experience in data science, data analytics, data engineering, biostatistics or a related field.
Strong Python and SQL skills.
Experience with data pipelines and data workflows.
Strong statistical and analytical reasoning.
Experience with clinical, healthcare, pharmaceutical or other sensitive data is a plus.
Familiarity with machine learning methods and data science libraries.
Excellent English. Dutch and/or French is a strong asset.
A relevant master’s degree or equivalent professional experience.




This is not a pure dashboarding or project-management role. You will work directly with data, engage with clinical and technical questions, and help define the way forward.




Growth opportunities

As the company grows, this role can evolve towards AI leadership, ownership of real-world evidence and clinical analytics, or a broader data science or data engineering leadership position.




Why join Cascador/moveUP?

You will join a driven team working on a digital health product with a real impact on people’s lives. We offer a flexible and collaborative environment, hybrid working in Brussels or Ghent, a competitive salary and substantial extra-legal benefits.

Cascador/moveUP is a Belgian scale-up that unlocks health data for better health by collecting, analysing and sharing it in a secure and privacy-preserving way.

About the Job

NISH Tech BV is an IT consulting and staffing company connecting highly skilled professionals with leading organizations across Europe. We support our clients with technology, digital transformation, data and enterprise solutions.

We are currently looking for an experienced Data Reporting & Visualization Specialist to join a leading banking organization in Brussels, Belgium.




Job Overview

The Data Reporting & Visualization Specialist will play a key role in transforming data into clear, actionable and impactful insights for business stakeholders.

The role involves understanding reporting and visualization requirements, preparing and structuring data, designing dashboards and reports, and managing the full lifecycle of reporting solutions while ensuring compliance with data governance and security standards.

The specialist will work closely with business stakeholders, Data Engineers and other data professionals to deliver sustainable and reusable data-driven solutions.

Capture requirements and translate them into prototypes and complete dashboards.
Prepare and assemble data required for reporting and visualization.
Design, develop, update, optimize and publish dashboards and reports.
Manage the full lifecycle of reporting solutions, including decommissioning where required.
Optimize and automate reporting and dashboard solutions.
Collaborate with Data Engineers to develop sustainable and governed data structures.
Promote reuse, consistency and alignment with the organization's data strategy.
Implement and advocate reporting and visualization best practices.
Ensure compliance with data governance and security guidelines.
Coach junior Data Visualization Specialists.
Document solutions and train users on effectively using reporting and visualization tools.

At least 6 years of relevant experience in Data Analytics and Visualization.

Proven experience designing and developing dashboards and data visualizations.
Knowledge of Data Warehouses, Data Marts, data extraction and data preparation processes.
Understanding of data governance and data security requirements.

Title: HR Data & Insights Specialist
Description:
HR Data & Insights Specialist

Location: 2/3 days in the office in Anderlecht

Company: A Global Biopharmaceutical Company




About the Role

We are looking for an experienced HR Data & Insights Specialist to join a global organisation and play a key role in transforming how Talent and HR data is used to support business decisions.

This is a highly collaborative role sitting at the intersection of HR, data analytics, technology and business analysis. You will work closely with Talent stakeholders, technology teams and external delivery partners to turn complex business questions into meaningful insights, scalable reporting solutions and intuitive analytics products.




The role offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to the continued development of a modern HR data and analytics environment, with a strong focus on Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, data quality, automation, self-service reporting and continuous improvement.




Key Responsibilities

HR Reporting & Data Analytics

Deliver accurate and insightful recurring and ad hoc HR/Talent reporting and analytics.
Work with stakeholders to understand business questions, clarify requirements and translate them into meaningful reporting outputs.
Analyse workforce and Talent data to identify trends, opportunities and actionable insights.
Develop, maintain and continuously improve reporting and analytics solutions using tools such as Power BI, Excel and R.
Ensure reporting solutions are reliable, well documented and fit for purpose.
Support stakeholders in making effective use of self-service reporting and analytics tools.
Promote data literacy and reduce reliance on manual reporting through improved self-service capabilities.




HR Data & Business Analysis

Act as a key data partner to Talent and HR stakeholders, understanding their priorities, processes and analytical requirements.
Translate business needs into clear data requirements, KPI definitions, calculation logic, user stories and acceptance criteria.
Work closely with business owners, technology teams and external partners to ensure data solutions meet business needs.
Provide guidance on data sources, field definitions, reporting logic and the processes that generate HR data.
Challenge requirements and proposed solutions constructively, recommending practical approaches that balance usability, performance, maintainability and available data.
Conduct gap analysis across the HR data landscape and contribute to the development of consistent, trusted data foundations.
Identify opportunities to improve data quality, automation, standardisation and reuse.




Analytics & Dashboard Delivery

Gather, document and prioritise requirements for dashboards, reports and analytics products.
Work with business and technology teams to develop intuitive, user-focused dashboards and data stories.
Define and validate KPIs, calculations and business rules.
Coordinate and execute User Acceptance Testing (UAT), ensuring solutions meet agreed requirements.
Identify and manage issues through to resolution, assessing the impact of changes and maintaining appropriate documentation.
Support the deployment, training and adoption of new analytics products.
Monitor the performance and effectiveness of reporting solutions and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
Contribute to dashboard governance, access management and the transition away from legacy reporting solutions.




Data & Analytics Projects

Support and deliver projects that enhance the HR reporting and analytics experience.
Develop analytical solutions, proof-of-concepts and scalable data products.
Work within an agile environment, collaborating with subject matter experts and technical teams to translate business requirements into effective solutions.
Support the migration and re-engineering of existing reporting solutions into modern data platforms and technologies.
Contribute to initiatives involving Microsoft Fabric, Power BI and related data technologies.
Maintain clear technical and business documentation, training materials and handover information.
Help ensure solutions are sustainable, supportable and capable of evolving with changing business needs.




Technology & Data Environment

The role will work across a modern HR data and analytics technology landscape, including:

Microsoft Fabric
Power BI
SQL
DAX
PySpark
Excel
R
Snowflake
Denodo
SuccessFactors
Neocase
PowerPoint




About You

We are looking for someone who combines strong technical data skills with excellent business and stakeholder management capabilities.




Qualifications:

Proven experience working with HR, Talent or workforce data within a reporting, analytics or business analysis environment.
Experience in Life Sciences.
Strong experience working with large datasets, including data preparation, transformation, validation, analysis and visualisation.
Strong Power BI capability, including data modelling, KPI development, dashboard creation and user-focused visualisation.
Experience working with Microsoft Fabric and lakehouse-based analytics environments.
Experience developing, maintaining or migrating R-based reporting or analytical solutions.
Working knowledge of SQL and DAX.
Strong business analysis skills, including requirements gathering, process analysis, KPI definition, user stories, impact assessments and UAT.
The ability to translate complex technical and analytical concepts into clear, practical language for non-technical stakeholders.
Strong stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to challenge constructively and influence decisions.
Experience working with business owners, technical teams and external delivery partners.
A structured and detail-oriented approach, with strong ownership of delivery, quality and deadlines.
A proactive, service-focused mindset and the ability to manage recurring reporting alongside project-based and ad hoc priorities.
A genuine interest in automation, standardisation, data quality and continuous improvement.




What Makes This Opportunity Interesting?

This is more than a traditional HR reporting position. You will have the opportunity to help shape the way a global organisation uses Talent data to make better decisions.

You will have exposure to both the business and technical sides of HR analytics, working on everything from stakeholder requirements and KPI definition through to dashboard development, data foundations, automation and the adoption of new analytics solutions.

For someone looking to develop their career across HR data, analytics, business analysis and modern data technology, this role offers a broad and impactful remit within a global environment.

Description:
Why Keyrus, Why Now!

Keyrus is an international group of 2,800 consultants and experts across 28 countries, built on a single conviction: AI does not transform businesses. Architected intelligence does. For more than 30 years, we have been building the data foundations that make intelligent systems work — designing the Operating System of the intelligent enterprise, where intelligence is embedded into the core of business processes to create sustainable value: we operationalise intelligence.

At Keyrus, you will not just develop skills - you will develop judgment. Title: BI Data Engineer
Description:
Location: Brussels, Belgium

Company: Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) Belgium

Employment Type: Full-time




Nature of the tasks

Create and maintain Enterprise Data Warehouses (EDW) and complex Business Intelligence Solutions (Data Lakes / Data Lakehouses).
Design modern Business Intelligence (BI) architectures (e.g., data lakehouse) for cloud, on premises, and hybrid environments, ensuring compliance with security and data residency requirements.
Gather and analyse business requirements specifically for data pipelines, storage, and reporting solutions.
Design and implement modern Extract, Transform, Load / Extract, Load, Transform (ETL/ELT) processes and orchestration workflows, incorporating data contracts and schema evolution management.
Implement and manage data virtualization layers to provide unified access to heterogeneous data sources while optimizing performance and security.
Design and implement data models (e.g., dimensional modeling) to support reporting and analytics, ensuring alignment with business requirements.
Design and build reporting and analytics applications, creating dashboards, KPIs, and self-service BI tools that deliver actionable insights to business stakeholders.
Design and optimize the physical database schema, including indexing, partitioning, and storage strategies, to balance performance, cost, and maintainability.
Conduct ongoing database performance analysis, tuning queries, optimizing resource utilization, and ensuring SLAs for latency and throughput are met.
Design and implement data quality frameworks and health monitoring processes that include data observability (lineage, freshness) and defined Service Level Agreements / Service Level Objectives (SLAs/SLOs).
Define and execute test programs for BI solutions, including data validation, regression tests, contract tests, and automated pipelines integrated into CI/CD.
Produce and maintain technical documentation (data dictionaries, lineage, design specifications, runbooks) to support transparency, governance, and audit readiness.
Perform deployment and configuration of BI systems and platforms, applying infrastructure-as-code, version control, and environment management practices.
Govern the BI semantic layer (KPIs, metrics catalog, naming conventions, row-level security) to ensure consistency and trusted insights.
Manage access controls and data security within BI platforms in alignment with GDPR and internal data protection policies.
Optimize cost and performance of BI platforms and warehouses (partitioning, caching, clustering, query optimization, resource scaling).
Define and enforce data lineage and stewardship practices, ensuring transparency, auditability, and compliance.
Enable self-service BI capabilities for business users through curated datasets, certified reports, and training/support.




Specific expertise and technologies

Knowledge of enterprise data warehouse design and architecture, including dimensional modelling and star/snowflake schema design.
Knowledge of data lake and lakehouse design patterns (e.g., Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg) to support large-scale analytics.
Excellent knowledge of relational database systems applied to data warehouse.
Knowledge of non-relational databases (e.g., MongoDB, Cassandra, Hadoop HBase) for handling unstructured and semi-structured data.
Excellent knowledge of SQL.
Knowledge of BI reporting and analytics tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Qlik) for enterprise dashboards and self-service analytics.
Knowledge of ETL and ELT tools (e.g., Informatica, Talend, dbt, Azure Data Factory) to manage enterprise data pipelines.
Knowledge of modelling tools (e.g., ERwin, SAP PowerDesigner, ArchiMate for data flows) to design logical and physical data models.
Knowledge of OLAP technologies (e.g., SSAS, Essbase) and data mining tools (e.g., SAS Enterprise Miner, RapidMiner).
Knowledge of near real-time data ingestion and change data capture (CDC) technologies (e.g., Kafka, Debezium, GoldenGate).
Knowledge of cloud BI architectures (e.g., Azure Synapse, Snowflake, AWS Redshift) to enable scalable analytics.
Knowledge of data governance and cataloguing practices (e.g., Collibra, Alation, Azure Purview) to ensure trusted data assets.
Knowledge of data observability practices (e.g., freshness, lineage, anomaly detection) to monitor and assure pipeline quality.




Minimum level of expertise

Normal




Certification and/or Standards

Optional: One of the following or an equivalent certification:

Microsoft Data Analyst Associate
Microsoft Azure Data Engineer Associate
Amazon Certified Data Analytics Specialty




Skills

Ability to apply rigour and consistency in BI development practices.
Ability to work in multi-cultural environment.
Ability to participate in multilingual meetings.
Ability to understand, speak and write English; one of French or Dutch is a plus
Talent for building relationships and adapting communication to the audience.
Ability to work in a team as well as autonomously.
Results-oriented mindset, focused on delivering.

Title: Business Analyst for Regulatory Reporting
Description:
Business Analyst for Regulatory Reporting

The Team

The Tribe Finance & Reporting supports Finance and Reporting teams by delivering robust data, systems, and reporting solutions within a complex and evolving regulatory environment. The Tribe plays a key role in enabling accurate and compliant reporting across domains such as Financial Reporting, Liquidity Reporting, Analytical Reporting, Deposit Guarantee Scheme (DGS), AnaCredit, and CICR.

About The Role

As a Business Analyst Regulatory Reporting, you act as the bridge between business and technology. While the role has a strong technical and data-oriented focus, success in this position requires a solid understanding of the regulatory reporting processes and regulatory context, enabling you to effectively translate business needs into data and system solutions.

A key focus area of the role is supporting the transformation of the reporting landscape, including the migration from an existing data warehouse to a modern public cloud-based data platform. In this context, you ensure continuity, consistency, and quality of data while aligning local Belgian reporting requirements with group-wide standards.

Key Responsibilities


Translate business needs and regulatory requirements into detailed data definitions, mappings, and functional specifications
Analyse and document required data elements, data lineage, and business rules
Ensure alignment between local Belgian reporting requirements and group data models
Contribute to the design and implementation of data solutions within the reporting platform
Collaborate closely with business stakeholders, data engineers, and IT teams to ensure accurate and consistent data delivery
Support testing activities by defining test cases, reviewing data outputs, and ensuring quality standards are met
Maintain documentation of data mappings, definitions, and reporting processes


How To Succeed


Holding a master’s degree in (business) economics or a comparable field ;
Minimum 3 years working experience in a change delivery role ;
Working knowledge on any data driven reporting and/or hands-on experience in data granular reporting is a plus ;
Ability to read & interpret regulatory documentation, reporting policies & IT-instructions ;
Having hands on proficient level of experience on SQL, Cognos, and Power BI ;

The Team

The Tribe Finance & Reporting supports Finance and Reporting teams by delivering robust data, systems, and reporting solutions within a complex and evolving regulatory environment. The Tribe plays a key role in enabling accurate and compliant reporting across domains such as Financial Reporting, Liquidity Reporting, Analytical Reporting, Deposit Guarantee Scheme (DGS), AnaCredit, and CICR.

About The Role

As a Business Analyst Regulatory Reporting, you act as the bridge between business and technology. While the role has a strong technical and data-oriented focus, success in this position requires a solid understanding of the regulatory reporting processes and regulatory context, enabling you to effectively translate business needs into data and system solutions.

A key focus area of the role is supporting the transformation of the reporting landscape, including the migration from an existing data warehouse to a modern public cloud-based data platform. In this context, you ensure continuity, consistency, and quality of data while aligning local Belgian reporting requirements with group-wide standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Translate business needs and regulatory requirements into detailed data definitions, mappings, and functional specifications
  • Analyse and document required data elements, data lineage, and business rules
  • Ensure alignment between local Belgian reporting requirements and group data models
  • Contribute to the design and implementation of data solutions within the reporting platform
  • Collaborate closely with business stakeholders, data engineers, and IT teams to ensure accurate and consistent data delivery
  • Support testing activities by defining test cases, reviewing data outputs, and ensuring quality standards are met
  • Maintain documentation of data mappings, definitions, and reporting processes

How To Succeed

  • Holding a master’s degree in (business) economics or a comparable field ;
  • Minimum 3 years working experience in a change delivery role ;
  • Working knowledge on any data driven reporting and/or hands-on experience in data granular reporting is a plus ;
  • Ability to read & interpret regulatory documentation, reporting policies & IT-instructions ;
  • Having hands on proficient level of experience on SQL, Cognos, and Power BI ;
  • Fluent in English. Dutch and/or French is a plus.

Further

  • Self-starter, self-organizing and able to work autonomously while effectively managing priorities ;
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability for results.

Title: Pricing Analyst
Description:
Todis, azienda di supermercati a marca privata, con 25 anni di storia e 300 punti di vendita è uno dei principali player del canale convenienza.


Lavorare in Todis, significa lavorare in un ambiente dinamico, organizzato ed innovativo.

La nostra convinzione è che ogni individuo possa portare un contributo unico al successo della nostra organizzazione.

In Todis accogliamo il cambiamento attraverso l’innovazione, la formazione e la sperimentazione, perseguendo il miglioramento continuo.

La nostra Vision: essere il luogo più accogliente dove fare la spesa e dove trovare prodotti buoni, genuini e alla portata di tutti.

La nostra Mission: selezionare prodotti e produttori per la marca privata di qualità e al giusto prezzo. Privilegiare i prodotti freschi e provenienti dai nostri territori. Lavorare ogni giorno in partnership con i nostri imprenditori.

Il nostro Purpose: per dare a tutti la possibilità di migliorare la qualità della vita e far fiorire l’economia locale per le generazioni di oggi e domani.

I nostri Valori: trasparenza ed integrità senso di responsabilità per il bene comune. Appartenenza e Lealtà Generosità e vicinanza, miglioramento continuo con ottimismo e fiducia nel futuro.

Posizione:

In IGES Srl crediamo che il giusto prezzo sia il punto d’incontro tra il valore dei nostri prodotti e la fiducia dei nostri clienti.

Siamo alla ricerca di un/una Pricing Analyst che, attraverso l'analisi dei dati e l'utilizzo di tecnologie all'avanguardia (Minderest), contribuisca a definire le strategie di prezzo per i nostri 300 punti vendita.

La risorsa avrà l'obiettivo di ottimizzare la competitività di Todis sul mercato, garantendo al contempo la marginalità aziendale.

In IGES, questa figura non è un semplice "gestore di listini", ma un consulente strategico capace di leggere le dinamiche del mercato in tempo reale.

In particolare, siamo alla ricerca di una figura dedicata e capace che lavorando a stretto contatto con l’area Acquisti e la Direzione Generale, si occuperà di:


Monitoraggio Competitivo : Utilizzo quotidiano della piattaforma Minderest per il monitoraggio dei prezzi della concorrenza e l’analisi del posizionamento di mercato.
Analisi Strategica : Elaborazione di report periodici sugli scostamenti di prezzo e suggerimento di azioni correttive per bilanciare volumi di vendita e margini.
Gestione Elasticità : Analisi dell'elasticità della domanda per le diverse categorie merceologiche (freschi, grocery, marca privata).
Supporto alle Promozioni: Collaborazione con l'ufficio Marketing e Acquisti per valutare l'efficacia delle campagne promozionali e il loro impatto sul posizionamento di lungo periodo.
Ottimizzazione Processi: Contribuire all'automazione dei flussi di aggiornamento prezzi tra i sistemi di analisi e l'ERP aziendale.


Requisiti:

Il/la nostro/a candidato/a ideale è in possesso delle seguenti caratteristiche:

Competenze Tecniche:


Esperienza: Almeno 2-3 anni in ruoli di analisi dati, preferibilmente nel settore GDO o Retail.
Padronanza avanzata di Excel (Pivot, Power Query, macro) per la manipolazione e pulizia di grandi dataset
Sistemi Gestionali (ERP): Conoscenza operativa di sistemi gestionali strutturati (preferibile esperienza su ambiente AS400) per l'estrazione e la verifica dei dati transazionali e delle anagrafiche prodotto.
Price Intelligence: Conoscenza (anche teorica o su piattaforme analoghe) di strumenti per il monitoraggio dei competitor come Minderest, con capacità di interpretare alert di prezzo e variazioni di assortimento.
Business Intelligence: Familiarità con piattaforme di Intelligent Planning ed EPM (costituirà titolo preferenziale la conoscenza di Board) per l'elaborazione di simulazioni "what-if", analisi della marginalità e visualizzazione di dashboard strategiche.
Data Visualization: Capacità di trasformare l'output dei sistemi (Board/Minderest) in presentazioni chiare e sintetiche per il supporto alle decisioni della Direzione Generale.


Competenze Trasversali:


Forte orientamento analitico e attenzione al dettaglio.
Capacità di sintesi per presentare dati complessi in modo chiaro alla Direzione Generale.
Proattività e curiosità verso le nuove tecnologie e le dinamiche del largo consumo.
Altro: Passione per il mondo GDO, orientamento al risultato e attitudine al lavoro di squadra.


Altre informazioni:

Retribuzione : RAL compresa tra € 35.000,00 e € 45.000,00 annui, commisurata all'esperienza e al livello delle competenze maturate.

Contratto: CCNL Commercio (CNEL - H011)

Sede di lavoro : Fiano Romano (RM)

Il presente annuncio è rivolto ad entrambi i sessi, ai sensi della Legge 903/77 e 125/91 e a persone appartenenti alle categorie protette (L. 68/99).

I candidati sono invitati a leggere l'informativa privacy ai sensi degli articoli 13 e 14 del Reg. EU 679/2016.

  • Monitoraggio Competitivo : Utilizzo quotidiano della piattaforma Minderest per il monitoraggio dei prezzi della concorrenza e l’analisi del posizionamento di mercato.
  • Analisi Strategica : Elaborazione di report periodici sugli scostamenti di prezzo e suggerimento di azioni correttive per bilanciare volumi di vendita e margini.
  • Gestione Elasticità : Analisi dell'elasticità della domanda per le diverse categorie merceologiche (freschi, grocery, marca privata).
  • Supporto alle Promozioni: Collaborazione con l'ufficio Marketing e Acquisti per valutare l'efficacia delle campagne promozionali e il loro impatto sul posizionamento di lungo periodo.
  • Ottimizzazione Processi: Contribuire all'automazione dei flussi di aggiornamento prezzi tra i sistemi di analisi e l'ERP aziendale.

Requisiti:

Il/la nostro/a candidato/a ideale è in possesso delle seguenti caratteristiche:

Competenze Tecniche:

  • Esperienza: Almeno 2-3 anni in ruoli di analisi dati, preferibilmente nel settore GDO o Retail.
  • Padronanza avanzata di Excel (Pivot, Power Query, macro) per la manipolazione e pulizia di grandi dataset
  • Sistemi Gestionali (ERP): Conoscenza operativa di sistemi gestionali strutturati (preferibile esperienza su ambiente AS400) per l'estrazione e la verifica dei dati transazionali e delle anagrafiche prodotto.
  • Price Intelligence: Conoscenza (anche teorica o su piattaforme analoghe) di strumenti per il monitoraggio dei competitor come Minderest, con capacità di interpretare alert di prezzo e variazioni di assortimento.
  • Business Intelligence: Familiarità con piattaforme di Intelligent Planning ed EPM (costituirà titolo preferenziale la conoscenza di Board) per l'elaborazione di simulazioni "what-if", analisi della marginalità e visualizzazione di dashboard strategiche.
  • Data Visualization: Capacità di trasformare l'output dei sistemi (Board/Minderest) in presentazioni chiare e sintetiche per il supporto alle decisioni della Direzione Generale.

Competenze Trasversali:

  • Forte orientamento analitico e attenzione al dettaglio.
  • Capacità di sintesi per presentare dati complessi in modo chiaro alla Direzione Generale.
  • Proattività e curiosità verso le nuove tecnologie e le dinamiche del largo consumo.
  • Altro: Passione per il mondo GDO, orientamento al risultato e attitudine al lavoro di squadra.

Altre informazioni:

Retribuzione : RAL compresa tra € 35.000,00 e € 45.000,00 annui, commisurata all'esperienza e al livello delle competenze maturate.

Contratto: CCNL Commercio (CNEL - H011)

Sede di lavoro : Fiano Romano (RM)

Il presente annuncio è rivolto ad entrambi i sessi, ai sensi della Legge 903/77 e 125/91 e a persone appartenenti alle categorie protette (L. 68/99).

I candidati sono invitati a leggere l'informativa privacy ai sensi degli articoli 13 e 14 del Reg. EU 679/2016.

Title: Senior Credit Risk Analyst
Description:
Job Description

Credit and Fraud Risk (CFR) is a global function, responsible for making the right credit and fraud risk decisions that uphold operational excellence, drive growth, and accelerate innovation across American Express. CFR combines technology and infrastructure with new computing techniques to make better risk decisions and provide real-time customer communications and fraud servicing.

How will you make an impact in this role?

You will join a team responsible for supporting and collaborating in the definition of credit strategies and models, credit risk monitoring and governance for the acquisition of individuals and small companies.

Thanks to your strong analytical mindset and data manipulation skills you will work on projects to implement automated monitoring systems while deep-diving on identifying opportunities of growth. You will be involved with the CFR International Centre of Excellence teams on defining and implement the best-in-class modelling solutions and strategies dedicated to acquisition for individuals and small companies.

Responsibilities

In particular, you will be requested the following activities:


Credit Risk Data and Processes: Identify new and innovative data points and sources to enhance our models and strategies, then support the integration of the new data in our systems. Identify opportunities for process efficiencies and contribute to work flow/process change redesign, forming a good understanding of the specific product or process.
Credit Risk Analysis: analyse, assess, and quantify the impact and probability of various risk scenarios and select the most appropriate course of action for the given situation.
Insights and Reporting: Develop, create and maintain credit risk reporting. Lead execution of complex reports, identifying and interpreting complex patterns and trends, and translating those insights into actionable recommendations. Applies comprehensive knowledge and skills to create relevant, lucid and effective reports.
Computer Skills: Independently supports business processes with comprehensive understanding and effective use of standard office equipment software packages (SQL and Python).
Credit Risk Management: Keep track of risk parameters, identifying any more deviations and reporting them to more senior colleagues.
Compliance Management: Works with guidance to achieve full compliance with applicable policy and regulations.
Analyse Alternatives and Recommend Solutions: Develop expert understanding of the end-to-end customer journeys, understand the systems where the data resides, the processes by which data is collated and stored and the methods available for data retrieval.


Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:


quantitative degree required.
from around 4 to 10 years of relevant work experience in any of these fields: Credit Risk, Modelling, Consulting, Data and Analytics.
Experience in automated reporting, models and analytical systems.
Strong analytical skills and professional proficiency in SQL and Python and automation tools (PowerBI is a plus).
Understanding of Credit Risk Modelling (preferred if Machine Learning).
Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and a strong willingness to learn.
Proficient in English and Italian.
Credit Bureau knowledge is a plus.


Non-considerations For Sponsorship

Employment eligibility to work with American Express in (the country) is required as the company will not pursue visa sponsorship for these positions.

Applicable National Collective Bargaining Agreement: Terziario, Distribuzione e Servizi

Salary Range: €48.000 to €72.000 annually + bonus + benefits

The advertised salary range is based on full-time employment and will be prorated for part-time roles.

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.

As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Title: Analyst, Data Analysis
Description:
Responsibilities

Job Description


Research, analysis and collection of reference data for Italian and foreign companies, in particular personal data and International Issuer Codes (LEI, S&P, Moody's, Fitch, Local code).
Identification of economic activity and assignment of international codes (ATECO, NACE, SIC, NAICS, GICS) based on official classifications by competent authorities.
Monitoring and management of the ordinary/extraordinary company operations (name change, re-domiciliation, M&A, etc.).
Monitoring and management of the upcoming companies on the Italian and international market.
Manages the terms of the Board of Directors/ordinary/extraordinary/special shareholders' meetings.
Updates Governance and shareholding of some client portfolios and Italian listed companies.
Analysis of the group structure, resulting in the identification and management of direct parents, ultimate parents, subsidiaries, public control, and public administration - elements fundamental to the majority of ICE products and services.
Basic live stock creation and mapping. creation and management of skeletal/partial ISINs in Database, coming from any internal or external supplier and linking them to the correct issuer.
Manages daily Stock Exchange Notices for topics of interest in the sector.
Monitors the Italian Official Gazette, controls the companies present in the Database and manages the variations.
Interacts with multinational colleagues (London, Dublin, New York) for data control and help desk.
Conduct a systematic analysis of companies subject to international sanctions, with the goal of accurately identifying and registering them within internal systems. This activity supports data integrity.
Design and implement automated solutions to optimize recurring processes in corporate data management and analysis, reducing operational time and enhancing efficiency and data quality.
Ensure daily management and updating of corporate data for Italy and other countries, including monitoring of Borsa Italiana exchange announcements, census of new Italian SPVs, PIR verification, input of Adjusted Non-Performing Loan Rate values, and monitoring of Banca d’Italia codes. Provide biannual support for updating macroeconomic data and geographic areas, and contribute to the maintenance of short company profiles.
Ensure the efficient and accurate management of information related to entities and securities, while guaranteeing the timely and high-quality fulfillment of client requests (daily challenges).
Collaborate with internal teams to enhance request traceability and identify potential workflow optimization opportunities.
Ensure continuous monitoring and updating of companies rated by credit agencies (e.g., Moody’s, S&P, Fitch) within internal systems, guaranteeing accurate registration and classification of rating data and consistency with official sources.
Involved in support activities related to the management of conflicts of interest for pension funds and the management of macroeconomic data extrapolated from EUROSTAT and ISTAT files.
Creates company profiles (business, shareholders, governance, etc.).
Uploads Bank of Italy counterpart codes.
Research of company documentation (Annual Report).


Knowledge And Experience


Bachelor’s degree in economics.
1+ years of experience in the financial services industry.
1+ years of experience querying / retrieving data from structured databases (SQL/Oracle. Python). Not mandatory but highly recommended
Technical knowledge of Artificial Intelligence, Python programming, and SQL. Not mandatory but highly recommended
Organized and structured with attention to detail.
Strong collaboration skills.
Strong communication skills.
Fluent English language proficiency (written and spoken).


Italy Base Salary Range

The expected base salary for this role is between 28,000 - 40,000 EUR.  The base salary range does not include Intercontinental Exchange’s incentive compensation.  While we provide this range as general guidance, at ICE we compensate employees based on objective and gender-neutral criteria including skillset, qualifications and experience of the individual. Regular full-time ICE employees are eligible for a suite of competitive employee benefits, including healthcare coverage.
