Description:
Job Description

Would you like to work in a dynamic, international, and constantly expanding environment? If you are looking for a company where Competence, Exclusivity, and Passion are the fundamental values of success, Engel & Völkers offers you the opportunity to make a difference. Join us!

For over 45 years, Engel & Völkers has been a global leader in residential and commercial real estate services within the premium segment. With more than 16,500 professionals active in over 1,000 locations across 35 countries and 5 continents, we represent a benchmark brand in international real estate. In Italy, our network includes 4 large Market Centers and over 100 franchised locations, constantly growing thanks to the excellence of our services and a curated selection of exclusive properties that meet the needs of an increasingly sophisticated clientele. All our team members embody the core values of our brand: competence, exclusivity, and passion. Every day, we strive to deliver impeccable service, selecting unique properties and catering to the needs of discerning international clients.

Based on our office in Rome we are hiring a:

Business Analyst & Digital Transformation (m/w/d)

In this role you will help shape the future of our commercial organization by identifying improvement opportunities and leading strategic initiatives that optimize processes, accelerate digital transformation, and improve business performance.

Working at the intersection of Operations, Technology, and Business Intelligence, you will bridge business needs with digital solutions, translating complex challenges into scalable initiatives that deliver measurable business results.

Key responsibilities:,


Lead Strategic Projects: Drive cross-functional initiatives from concept to implementation, ensuring measurable business impact.
Drive Continuous Improvement: Identify operational improvement opportunities, implement scalable process and technology solutions, and measure their impact against defined KPIs.
Enable Data-Driven Decisions: Develop analyses, dashboards, and KPI frameworks that support operational excellence and management decision-making.
Technology Enablement: Translate business requirements into scalable digital solutions and drive the implementation of new CRM and commercial system capabilities.
Drive Automation & Innovation: Leverage automation, digitalization, and AI-enabled solutions to simplify processes and improve operational performance.
Collaborate Across Functions: Partner closely with international Operations, Sales, Recruiting, Training, Marketing, and Technology teams to deliver business solutions.
Business Performance & Insights: Deliver data-driven insights and recommendations that support business decisions and continuous performance improvement.


Your profile:,


Master's degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Economics, Information Systems, or a related field.
3–5 years of experience in management consulting, business operations, project management, or a comparable analytical role.
Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills with experience delivering cross-functional projects.
Proven stakeholder management skills with the ability to translate business challenges into scalable solutions.
Excellent communication and presentation skills with a curious, proactive, and hands-on mindset.
Affinity for technology, data, and process optimization; experience with BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) is an advantage.
Experience with CRM platforms is an advantage, but curiosity and the ability to quickly learn new technologies are more important.
Fluent in Italian and English.


What we offer:,


Work closely with senior leadership and cross-functional teams.
Gain broad exposure across Operations, Sales, Technology, and Business Intelligence.
Join a collaborative, international environment focused on innovation and continuous improvement.
Benefit from excellent professional development and long-term career opportunities.
Individual targets based annual bonus


Join us and help transform the way we work through better processes, smarter technology, and data-driven decisions.

Title: Associate Consultant - AI & Advanced Technology
Description:
We are seeking a talented individual to join our Risk Advanced Technology team at Risk Consulting through our Professional Graduate Programme. This role will be based in Rome for a hybrid role.

Risk Consulting is a management consulting firm that provides risk management services as part of Marsh Risk, a leader in insurance brokerage and head of the international Marsh Group, a group of expertise in strategic and management consulting, reinsurance, human capital, and investments (Oliver Wyman, Guy Carpenter, Mercer).

The Risk Advanced Technology practice develops innovative risk management services using advanced technologies (Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Process Mining, and Business Intelligence) to support leading public and private organizations.

We will count on you to:


Support the application of Machine Learning and AI techniques to analyze risk phenomena across heterogeneous domains (e.g., financial risk, operational risk), detect anomalies/fraud, reduce processing times, and contribute to simplifying business processes with a view to intelligent automation.
Contribute to the development of quantitative and financial models, also in the Credit Risk area (e.g., PD, LGD, EAD, Pricing, stress testing, ECL), with the support of more senior professionals and in line with leading market best practices.
Perform data analysis, dynamic reporting, risk monitoring dashboards, and early warning systems using Business Intelligence and Advanced Analytics tools.
Support clients in developing and evolving risk management frameworks and digital transformation processes.
Collaborate in the development of new solutions and methodologies (e.g., Generative AI applied to risk management, explainable ML models, process automation, advanced analytics).
Take part in the various project phases: requirements gathering, functional analysis, modeling, implementation, testing, and go-live support.
Prepare deliverables, analyses, and project presentations, contributing to the quality of the work and the clarity of communication with the client.
Interact with clients and project stakeholders, with team support, presenting analytical evidence and results clearly and effectively.


What you need to have:


Master’s degree or higher in Management, Management Engineering, Computer Science, Statistics, Financial Mathematics, or related STEM disciplines, with an excellent academic record.
Technical skills (vertical) in one or more of the following areas:
Data analysis and modeling using Business Intelligence tools (e.g., Power BI).
Basic/intermediate knowledge of Machine Learning / AI: supervised and unsupervised models (e.g., classification, regression, clustering, anomaly detection).
Familiarity with Credit Risk models and concepts (e.g., PD, LGD, EAD, ECL).
Good knowledge of Python for data analysis and automation (e.g., pandas, scikit-learn, openpyxl, or equivalent libraries).
Knowledge of Power Platform tools (e.g., Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse) is a plus.
Basic/intermediate knowledge of relational databases.
Management skills (horizontal):
Ability to draft project documentation and prepare presentations and deliverables.
Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and a structured approach to problem solving.
Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with a collaborative mindset and ability to engage with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Interest in risk management, business processes, and digital transformation.


What makes you stand out:


Experience, even at an early stage, in developing solutions that combine analytics, Machine Learning, LLMs, and code-based tools (e.g., Python) and/or low-code tools.
Familiarity with the banking and credit regulatory context (e.g., Basel framework, CRR, EBA Guidelines/RTS, IFRS 9).
Knowledge of Data Visualization and Data Management tools (e.g., Power BI, DAX, SQL, Azure).
Knowledge of the main Risk Management frameworks (e.g., ISO 31000, COSO Framework).
Interest in Generative AI applications for risk management.
Any relevant certifications or training paths in data, risk, analytics, or cloud.


Why join our team:


You will join an international, cross-business organization, part of a leading group in professional services in Strategy, Risk, and People.
You will have the opportunity to work on innovative projects in the field of Risk Management, with real-world applications for the Italian Public Administration and the private sector.
You will be part of a growth-oriented environment, with the opportunity to develop quantitative, technological, and consulting skills while working closely with senior professionals.


What we offer:


Tailored career progression: The programme starts with a 6-month internship (monthly compensation: €800) and €8 meal vouchers per working day, smart working policy and well-being initiatives. At the end of the 6-month internship, based on the tutors' evaluation, the internship can proceed through an apprenticeship contract offering a starting gross annual salary of €28.000. The National Collective Bargaining Agreement (NCBA) applied is 'Terziario, Distribuzione e Servizi’.
Additional attractive benefits offered with the apprenticeship contract: insurance coverages, supplementary pension plan, facultative health assistance, flexible benefits, optional stock purchase plan. Further details will be shared during the selection process.


Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) is a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit marsh.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Marsh is committed to creating a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

CCNL applicato: ANIA
Tipologia contrattuale: Tempo indeterminato.

Per la posizione in oggetto la retribuzione annua lorda (RAL) iniziale sarà non inferiore a € 40.000. La RAL sarà comunque commisurata all’effettiva esperienza maturata, al livello delle competenze acquisite e alla corrispondenza del profilo ricercato col profilo della risorsa.

Senior Consultant - AI & Advanced technology

Risk Consulting is looking for candidate to join our Risk Advanced Technology team as Senior Consultant based in Rome for a hybrid role.

Risk Consulting is a management consulting firm that provides risk management services as part of Marsh Risk, a leader in insurance brokerage and head of the international Marsh Group, a group of expertise in strategic and management consulting, reinsurance, human capital, and investments (Oliver Wyman, Guy Carpenter, Mercer).

The Risk Advanced Technology practice develops innovative risk management services using advanced technologies (Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Process Mining, and Business Intelligence) to support leading public and private organizations.

We count on you to:


Support clients in developing integrated risk management frameworks and in the digital transformation of risk management processes;
Analyze, map, and redesign business processes to identify inefficiencies, pain points, control gaps, and automation opportunities, with a particular focus on AI-enabled transformation initiatives;
Support clients in the assessment and reengineering of operational and control processes, leveraging AI, process mining, intelligent automation, and advanced analytics solutions. Gather and formalize business and functional requirements, translating client needs into actionable process improvement roadmaps and technology-enabled solutions;
Contribute to the design and implementation of AI use cases aimed at improving process efficiency, strengthening controls, reducing manual activities, and enhancing decision-making;
Work closely with business, risk, compliance, audit, and technology stakeholders to ensure that process transformation initiatives are aligned with governance, regulatory, and internal control requirements;
Support the execution of diagnostic assessments, gap analyses, and target operating model designs in the context of business transformation and innovation programs;
Contribute to project delivery across the full lifecycle, from current-state analysis and solution design to implementation support, testing, go-live, and change management;
Mentor junior team members and contribute to the development of internal methodologies, assets, and thought leadership on AI-driven process transformation;
Build Business Intelligence and Advanced Analytics solutions for dynamic reporting, risk monitoring dashboards, and early warning systems;
Interact with clients and all stakeholders involved in the projects, presenting results and strategic recommendations clearly and effectively.

Master’s degree or higher in Management or Industrial Engineering, with excellent academic results;
Proven experience in consulting projects with proven expertise in the following areas:

Good understanding of AI-enabled business transformation, including the application of Artificial Intelligence, intelligent automation, process mining, or analytics to improve business processes
Consulting projects focused on business process analysis, process reengineering, operating model review, or transformation initiative
Solid experience in gathering business and functional requirements, process mapping, drafting functional specifications, and supporting the implementation of technology-driven solutions
Experience in interacting with multiple stakeholders, facilitating workshops, and presenting complex topics clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
Strong project management attitude, attention to detail, and ability to manage workstreams autonomously in a client-facing environment
Excellent knowledge of PowerPoint and Excel; familiarity with process mapping and workflow documentation tools is a plus
Fluent Italian and English, both written and spoken

Experience in AI transformation projects with a specific focus on process optimization, redesign, governance, and adoption
Knowledge of LLM models: prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), orchestration of AI agents and copilots, evaluation of model performance, and application of guardrails and governance mechanisms to ensure reliability, explainability, and compliance in business processes
Experience in internal controls, internal audit, compliance, or assurance-related projects, as well as familiarity with the most widely used risk management frameworks (e.g., ISO 31000, COSO Framework), with the ability to connect process reengineering initiatives to control frameworks and verification needs
Knowledge of process mining tools and methodologies for identifying bottlenecks, deviations, and improvement opportunities
Familiarity with risk and control frameworks, governance models, and operating models in regulated or complex environments
Experience in projects involving the review of end-to-end processes within finance, operations, procurement, compliance, or risk functions
Knowledge of low-code / no-code and workflow automation platforms (e.g., Power Platform, Power Automate) and their use in process transformation initiatives
Relevant certifications in process improvement, project management, audit, or risk management
Knowledge of advanced Data Visualization tools (Power BI, DAX, Qlik) and Data Management tools (e.g., Azure, SQL, SAS)


Why join our team:


An international, cross-business network with leaders in Strategy, Risk, and People professional services
The opportunity to design and apply innovative risk solutions in practice for use by the Italian Public Administration (e.g., central government bodies and public-owned companies) and the private sector

The position is offered on a permanent basis.

Description:
At Perrigo, we are driven by our mission to Makes Lives Better Through Trusted Health and Wellness Solutions, Accessible to All. We are proud to be a Top 10 player in the European Consumer Self-Care market and the largest U.S. store brand provider of over the counter and infant formula. Dedicated to providing The Best Self-Care for Everyone, we are the people behind the brands you trust. We are Opill®, Compeed®, Solpadeine®, NiQuitin®, and many more. We Are Perrigo. We pride ourselves on fostering an inclusive, collaborative culture where each person can experience a sense of belonging.

Join us on our One Perrigo journey as we evolve to win in self-care.

Description Overview

The E-Commerce Conversion & Digital Shelf Specialist plays a key role in optimizing online product visibility, content quality, and conversion performance across Amazon,other marketplace platforms and online players.

The candidate supports the enhancement of the entire shopper journey—from product discovery and search visibility to purchase conversion—through data analysis, digital shelf optimization, marketplace best practices, and emerging AI-powered solutions.

He/she combines strong analytical skills with hands-on ecommerce experience, leveraging data and insights to improve product performance, drive conversion, and support sustainable business growth. Working cross-functionally with Marketing, Sales, Regulatory, and Retail Media teams, the Specialist contributes to the delivery of best-in-class product content and an outstanding online shopping experience

Scope of the Role

Digital Shelf Optimization


Monitor and analyze digital shelf performance using Profitero or similar tools.
Action on key metrics including:
Share of Search
Content Quality Scores
Competitive Benchmarking
Pricing and Visibility Performance
Identify opportunities to improve product discoverability and conversion.


Product Content Excellence


Support the optimization of Product Detail Pages (PDPs) across Amazon, other marketplaces and online players.
Improve:
Product titles
Bullet points
Product descriptions
Images and A+ Content
Implement keyword strategies to increase visibility and organic ranking.
Conduct regular content audits and recommend improvements.


Conversion Optimization


Analyze shopper behavior and performance data throughout the ecommerce funnel.
Monitor:
Organic visibility
Traffic performance
Click-through rates
Conversion rates
Support testing and optimization initiatives aimed at increasing sales performance.


AI-Driven Content Enhancement


Leverage AI tools to improve content quality and productivity.
Optimize content for AI-powered search and discovery environments.
Stay informed on emerging trends in AI, ecommerce, and digital shelf management.


Cross-Functional Collaboration

Strongly partnering -with Marketing, Sales, Regulatory, and Category teams to ensure content accuracy and consistency.


Collaborate with Retail Media - to support campaign effectiveness through high-quality PDP content.


Reporting & Insights


Prepare performance reports and dashboards.
Translate data into actionable recommendations.
Support the implementation of continuous improvement initiatives based on performance insights.


KPI


Conversion Rate (CVR)
Share of Search
Organic Visibility
Digital Shelf Content Score
Sales Growth on Priority SKUs
Content Compliance and Completeness
Contribution to Revenue Growth and Media Efficiency


Experience Required

Minimum 4 years of experience in ecommerce / marketplace environments


Fluent English
Strong experience with Amazon ecosystem (Vendor or Seller)
Data-driven mindset with mandatory experience in tools such as Profitero (preferred) or equivalent
Solid knowledge of:
marketplace SEO
ranking algorithms
conversion optimization
Experience or strong interest in:
AI / Generative AI applied to ecommerce
content optimization for LLMs and AI-driven discovery systems
use of AI tools for content generation, testing, and performance improvement


Benefits

We believe our people are our greatest asset. Alongside competitive compensation, we offer benefits tailored to supporting you and your family, as well as career development opportunities to ensure you feel valued and supported, both professionally and personally.

Find out more about Total Rewards at Perrigo.

Hybrid Working Approach

We love our offices and the setting they provide for in-person collaboration and celebration. But we also appreciate the opportunity to work remotely can energise you too, so we promote flexibility with the ability to work two days a week from home in many roles.

Title: Junior Data Scientist and Manager
Company: Energy to Community S.B. A R.L.
Description:
COLLABORATION OPPORTUNITY




Junior Data Scientist and Manager – Piattaforma AI per gli Investimenti a Impatto




CHI SIAMO




Energy To Community Società Benefit a Responsabilità Limitata (E2C S. B. A R. L.), spin-off nato da ricercatori e studenti dell'Università LUISS Guido Carli, è alla ricerca di una risorsa che si unisca al Team per tradurre metodologie di valutazione dell'impatto dirette a misurare la pre-eleggibilità per investimenti di lungo termine in strumenti digitali e autonomi.       




La caratteristica della nostra metodologia risiede nell’accento posto sul ruolo di soggetti sociali o economici deboli, come le nuove generazioni, le PMI, individui e comunità vulnerabili nella pianificazione, progettazione, realizzazione e gestione di infrastrutture e innovazioni sostenibili e sulla convinzione che gli investitori di lungo termine debbano orientarsi a misurare e premiare la produzione di un impatto multidimensionale che contempli un ruolo dei soggetti sociali o economici deboli nella governance di queste infrastrutture e innovazioni.




Stiamo cercando una persona che ci aiuti a tradurre e ingegnerizzare in codice il framework metodologico e le relative logiche di valutazione che utilizziamo per misurare la pre-eleggibilità di tali investimenti a impatto, trasformando criteri e logiche di valutazione sviluppati in ambito accademico in uno strumento digitale concreto, scalabile e utilizzabile dagli investitori




LA MISSIONE




Costruire e rendere operativa una piattaforma digitale basata anche sull'integrazione di soluzioni di Intelligenza Artificiale, che generi automaticamente un Pre-Eligibility Form, lo strumento che permette di filtrare rapidamente i progetti di investimento maturi che meritano approfondimento.




DI COSA TI OCCUPERAI




•      Sviluppo backend e frontend della piattaforma

•      Progettazione del database e dei modelli dati

•      Traduzione di metriche per investimenti di lungo termine, criteri ESG e di impact investing in logiche applicative

•      Testing, iterazione e ottimizzazione del prodotto

•      Collaborazione diretta con il team di E2C

•      Documentazione tecnica e knowledge sharing




COSA CERCHIAMO IN TE




•      Formazione in Data and Computer Science, Ingegneria Informatica o percorsi affini (anche in corso)

•      Esperienza di sviluppo web: backend, frontend, costruzione e gestione databases

•      Curiosità per la finanza a impatto, la sostenibilità e le tecnologie emergenti

•      Spirito da startup e spin off: autonomia, velocità di esecuzione, voglia di intraprendere

•      Buona conoscenza dell’italiano e dell'inglese, scritto e parlato

•      Costituisce un plus l'esperienza con data visualization e UX/UI

JOB TITLE: Data Scientist

TYPE OF CONTRACT: Regular Consultant (CST)

UNIT/DIVISION: Private Sector Partnerships (PSP), Individual Fundraising Team

DUTY STATION (City, Country): Remote (administrative DS is Rome, HQ)

DURATION: 11 months

SUPERVISOR: Head of Insights and Strategic Enablement

BACKGROUND AND PURPOSE OF THE ASSIGNMENT:

The United Nations World Food Programme (WFP) is the world's largest humanitarian organization fighting hunger worldwide. Private Sector Partnerships (PSP) is responsible for growing and nurturing engagement with individual supporters, corporate partners, foundations and philanthropists to mobilize resources for WFP's mission.

As WFP continues to expand its individual fundraising (IF) programmes across WFP.org and ShareTheMeal, there is an increasing need to leverage advanced analytics, machine learning, artificial intelligence, and predictive modelling to optimize fundraising performance and long-term donor value. The Insights & Strategic Enablement function provides analytics, business intelligence, forecasting and strategic insight services to support evidence-based decision-making across PSP.

The Data Scientist will play a critical role in transforming large and complex datasets into actionable insights, predictive models, and AI-driven solutions that improve fundraising effectiveness and supporter engagement.

The role will work closely with fundraising, digital, technology, business intelligence, and data engineering teams within IF and more broadly PSP.

ACCOUNTABILITIES/RESPONSIBILITIES:

Reporting to the Head of Insights and Strategic Enablement, the data scientist will be responsible for providing data science, machine learning, and AI services in support of IF’s global data and analytics priorities, including deriving insights from large-scale datasets including transactional, web, app and experimentational.


Collaborate with PSP stakeholders, data owners, product teams, and technical counterparts to translate business needs into analytical solutions, document methods and results, and support adoption of data-driven recommendations.
Design, build, train, evaluate, and deploy machine learning and data science models that support segmentation, clustering, prediction, fundraising optimization and donor engagement. Apply the correct modeling technique; supervised or unsupervised to meet the differing business need.
Apply advanced AI techniques, including natural language processing, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, prompt engineering, and agentic workflows, where appropriate to automate analysis, improve decision support, and enhance knowledge discovery.
Perform exploratory data analysis, feature engineering, model evaluation, hyperparameter tuning, and model optimization to ensure analytical outputs are accurate, explainable, scalable, and fit for purpose.
Implement or assist tech and product teams to implement and operationalize data science models.
Rigorously review model performance and refine or retire where appropriate, maintaining a repository of solutions.
Contribute and collaborate with wider community of data scientists within WFP and sister agencies, keeping abreast and raising awareness to PSP colleagues of cutting-edge developments.
Other tasks as required.


DELIVERABLES AT THE END OF CONTRACT


Development of a data science pipeline for Individual Fundraising; capturing needs, data assets and projects with an implementation model.
Continually develop data science infrastructure and capabilities. Work with the engineering teams to operationalize models.
Development of a repository of data science models that have been developed; define review periods and maintain a code library.
Become a champion of Data Science, Machine Learning and AI within PSP; showcase possibilities and successful implementations.


QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:

Minimum Qualifications And Experience

Six years of relevant experience plus a university degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Statistics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field. Demonstrated experience working with large-scale datasets and building machine learning or AI solutions is required. Working knowledge of cloud platforms and modern data science tooling is considered an advantage.

Skills and Competencies:


Proficiency in programming languages such as Python or R is crucial for a data scientist.
Solid understanding of statistics is essential. The candidate should be familiar with concepts such as hypothesis testing, regression analysis, probability distributions, and statistical modeling techniques.
Expertise in traditional machine learning techniques, including supervised and unsupervised learning, segmentation, clustering, prediction, classification, regression, feature engineering, model evaluation, and model selection.
Strong experience with sentiment analysis, natural language processing, large language models, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, and agentic AI workflows, with the ability to identify practical use cases and implement responsible AI solutions.
Excellent oral and written skills; excellent drafting, formulation, reporting skills.
Excellent interpersonal skills; culturally and socially sensitive; ability to work inclusively and collaboratively with a range of partners, including grassroots community members, religious and youth organizations, and authorities at different levels; familiarity with tools and approaches of communications for development.
Ability to work and adapt professionally and effectively in a challenging environment; ability to work effectively in a multicultural team of international and national personnel.
Self-motivated, ability to work on MVPs in an agile environment; ability to work with tight deadlines.
Sound security awareness.
Have affinity with or interest in leveraging AI in humanitarian domain volunteerism as an enabler for durable development, and the UN System.


Languages:

Proficiency (read/ write/ speak) in English.

Diversità, equità, inclusione e processo di selezione

Questa opportunità è aperta a tutte e tutti, abbiamo a cuore l'”unicità” di ciascuno perché crediamo che i differenti punti di vista, la pluralità di esperienze e prospettive siano un motore fondamentale per l’innovazione.

In Enel, valorizziamo diversità, equità e inclusione come pilastri della nostra cultura e in quanto ispirano ambienti di lavoro aperti, dinamici e collaborativi, capaci di generare un autentico senso di appartenenza. Li integriamo in ogni fase della gestione delle persone, incluso il processo di selezione, che progettiamo su misura per ogni ruolo, con l’obiettivo di riconoscere e valorizzare i talenti, le competenze e le storie di ciascun candidato e candidata.

Il processo di selezione prevede un primo colloquio motivazionale e attitudinale con il Recruiting, seguito da un colloquio tecnico con l’HR e la linea di business di riferimento. Vuoi essere protagonista del cambiamento? Candidati ora ed entra a far parte del team per guidare insieme a noi la transizione energetica!

Chi siamo

Enel è una multinazionale dell’energia e un operatore integrato leader nei mercati globali dell’energia e delle rinnovabili, presente in 27 Paesi nel mondo. A livello mondiale, è il più grande operatore di rinnovabili, il primo operatore di reti di distribuzione elettrica per numero di clienti serviti e il maggiore operatore retail per numero di clienti [1].

Enel produce elettricità con una capacità totale di oltre 92 GW. Enel Green Power, che all’interno del Gruppo Enel gestisce le rinnovabili, conta su una capacità totale di 67 GW con un mix di generazione che include impianti eolici, solari, geotermici, idroelettrici e di accumulo, in Europa, nelle Americhe, in Africa, Asia e Oceania.

Nel Gruppo, Enel Commercial è dedicata ai clienti di tutto il mondo con l’obiettivo di fornire loro prodotti e servizi in maniera efficiente in base ai loro bisogni energetici, incoraggiandoli verso un uso più consapevole e sostenibile dell’energia. Descrizione e requisiti

Se sei appartenente alle categorie protette (art. 1 L.68/99) e sei neolaureata/o magistrale in discipline economico-finanziarie, STEM o Giurisprudenza, ti appassionano i numeri e vuoi capire come le decisioni strategiche prendano forma attraverso dati, analisi e processi nel mondo dell’energia, l’opportunità di stage nell’area Amministrazione, Finanza e Controllo (AFC) di Enel è l’occasione giusta per te!

Con chi lavorerai

Entrare in Enel Spa nell’area AFC significa lavorare a stretto contatto con funzioni diverse, conoscere i principali processi economico-finanziari di un grande Gruppo internazionale e avere l’opportunità di costruire un bagaglio di competenze professionali di grande valore.

Cosa farai

Durante il tuo percorso di stage potrai supportare e affiancare i team nelle loro sfide quotidiane per:

  • Trasformare i numeri in informazioni utili per supportare le decisioni attraverso la raccolta, analisi e consolidamento di dati economico-finanziari;
  • Individuare gli strumenti finanziari migliori a supporto del business;
  • Monitorare i principali rischi economico-finanziari, operativi e industriali del Gruppo;
  • Supportare le attività di monitoraggio e controllo dei processi interni;
  • Predisporre i bilanci del Gruppo Enel e presidiare la gestione amministrativo-contabile;
  • Gestire le attività fiscali del Gruppo;
  • Contribuire all'evoluzione dei processi attraverso strumenti digitali, data analytics e soluzioni innovative.

Chi cerchiamo

Cerchiamo persone motivate e curiose, che abbiano voglia di mettersi in gioco, di andare oltre l’approccio tradizionale e di contribuire con idee nuove, spirito critico e soluzioni smart.

Sono fondamentali flessibilità e spirito d’iniziativa nell’elaborazione di idee e soluzioni, insieme a una forte determinazione nel raggiungimento degli obiettivi.

La persona ideale possiede una solida attitudine analitica, precisione e attenzione ai dettagli, unite alla capacità di lavorare nel rispetto delle scadenze. Completano il profilo buone capacità relazionali, capacità di lavoro in team ed interesse per temi economico-finanziari, amministrativi o di controllo.

Cosa porterai

Requisiti minimi

  • Appartenenza al collocamento mirato art.1 L. 68/99;
  • Laurea Magistrale in: Economia, Finanza, Statistica, Matematica, Ingegneria Gestionale, Giurisprudenza o affini;
  • Conoscenza del pacchetto office, in particolare Excel e PowerPoint;
  • Conoscenza della lingua inglese. La conoscenza dello spagnolo costituisce un titolo preferenziale;
  • Costituisce un plus la familiarità con strumenti di intelligenza artificiale applicati all’ambito economico-finanziario.

Perché unirsi a noi?

  • Stage extracurriculare di 6 mesi
  • Rimborso spese di 800 euro/mese + buoni pasto.
  • Possibilità di lavoro flessibile e da remoto in accordo alle esigenze organizzative
  • Percorsi di formazione ed empowerment personale

Title: IT Specialist – Automation, Data Integration & Operations
Description:
In un'ottica di potenziamento della nostra funzione IT, Banca Finnat Euramerica S.p.A. seleziona un professionista qualificato per la posizione di IT Specialist – Automation, Data Integration & Operations presso la sede di Roma.




La risorsa inserita opererà con un elevato livello di autonomia, gestendo cicli di progetto end-to-end con supervisione minima. La figura risponderà direttamente alle esigenze operative della Banca attraverso un approccio pragmatico e una spiccata attitudine al problem solving.




Principali responsabilità e attività:

Sviluppo e Manutenzione Applicativa: progettazione, sviluppo e manutenzione di script, procedure e moduli software orientati all'automazione dei processi interni e all'integrazione dei dati.
Gestione Database e Querying: ottimizzazione e gestione di interrogazioni e strutture dati su database relazionali e ambienti legacy.
Gestione delle Elaborazioni: monitoraggio, coordinamento e gestione dei flussi batch operativi, assicurandone la corretta esecuzione e la tempestiva risoluzione delle anomalie.
Integrazione Dati, Flussi e Connettività: gestione dello scambio sicuro dei flussi informativi e dei file aziendali, configurando e monitorando protocolli di trasmissione dedicati (es. FIX e SFTP).
Interfacciamento con Fornitori Esteri: gestione dei rapporti tecnici, delle richieste di supporto e dell'allineamento operativo con partner e fornitori internazionali in lingua inglese.
Supporto Operativo: contributo alla gestione dei rilasci software, alla personalizzazione della documentazione tecnica e al monitoraggio costante delle procedure operative.




Requisiti Tecnici Richiesti:

Linguaggi e Framework: ottima conoscenza di Python e Java; è preferibile l'esperienza con HTML e ambienti applicativi web (es. Apache Tomcat).
Database: solida padronanza di MySQL e buona familiarità con DB2.
Protocolli: comprovata esperienza nella configurazione e gestione di flussi certi tramite connessioni FIX e protocolli SFTP.
Ambienti Legacy (AS400): la conoscenza dei linguaggi RPG e CL costituisce un titolo preferenziale; in alternativa, si richiede una forte predisposizione e rapidità nell'apprendimento di tali tecnologie.
Intelligenza Artificiale: esperienza pratica nell'integrazione di soluzioni avanzate di Intelligenza Artificiale all'interno di architetture aziendali. Capacità di implementare API di modelli generativi (LLM) e altri servizi AI (come Machine Learning e Natural Language Processing - NLP) per connettere archivi di dati, CRM e applicativi custom, sviluppando soluzioni di automazione intelligente e ottimizzazione dei processi.
Lingue straniere: ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese, scritta e parlata, per l'interfacciamento quotidiano con i partner esteri.




Retribuzione: RAL compresa tra 40.000€ e 45.000€ annui, commisurata all'effettiva esperienza.

Title: Senior Data Scientist GenAI
Description:
Are you looking for a new challenge?

Fancy helping us shape the future of motor insurance?

Prima could be the place for you.

Since 2015, we’ve been using our love of data and tech to rethink motor insurance and bring drivers a great experience at a great price. Our story began in Italy, where we’ve quickly become the number one online motor insurance provider. In fact, we’re trusted by over 5 million drivers. And now we’re expanding to help millions more drivers in the UK and Spain.

We’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our AI team focused on bringing ML & Generative AI into the heart of our operations (e.g. claims, underwriting, customer support).

In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to redefine the core operative processes, leveraging ML & GenAI techniques to enhance not only efficiency but, most importantly, the overall effectiveness and quality of outcomes.

You’ll collaborate with data scientists, engineers, and business leaders to design and deliver AI-driven products that create tangible business value and redefine the future of ops at Prima.

Excited to make an impact? Here are the details

What You’ll Do


Lead the end-to-end development of ML & GenAI solutions to transform the operations journey, from problem framing and data exploration to production deployment, tackling business challenges with autonomy and scientific rigor;
Set and uphold high technical standards across multiple AI initiatives, ensuring quality, scalability, and consistency;
Mentor fellow DSs and accelerate team learning, providing structure in the way of working, and driving a culture of experimentation and continuous improvement.


What We’re Looking For


Extensive experience (3+ years) in data science or applied machine learning, leading end-to-end initiatives in complex technical domains and delivering measurable business impact through ML and GenAI solutions;
Strong analytical and quantitative mindset able to translate data into insights, assess model performance, and guide decision-making with evidence and clarity;Structured problem solver skilled at framing ambiguous challenges, defining success metrics, and communicating results to both technical and non-technical audiences;Practical technical experience in coding (strong proficiency in Python and knowledge of coding best practices) and in ML/GenAI (experience with building ML models using frameworks such as scikit-learn and XGBoost, and familiarity with leveraging GenAI LLMs via APIs like OpenAI GPT or Gemini);
Curious and adaptive leader, proactive in exploring new methods, improving processes, and driving innovation in a fast-evolving environment.


Nice-to-Have


Global mindset: Experience working across countries or multi-market products;
Language skills: usiness proficiency in Italian or Spanish, in addition to English.


€55,000 - €75,000 a year

Why you’ll love it here

We want to make Prima a happy and empowering place to work. So if you decide to join us, you can expect plenty of perks.

💵 Competitive compensation: We offer a performance-based bonus of up to 7,5% of the fixed salary for this position.

🤸 Work Your Way: Enjoy full flexibility – work from home, the office or a mix of both. Plus, work from anywhere for up to 30 days a year.

🏁 Grow with us: We may move fast at Prima, but we move together. Get access to learning resources, mentorship and a growth plan tailored to you.

🌈 Thrive and perform: Your best work begins when you feel your best. Enjoy private healthcare, gym discounts, wellbeing programs and mental health support.

Think you’re a match? Apply now.

At Prima, we celebrate uniqueness. If you don’t meet every requirement but are passionate about this role, we still want to hear from you. Innovation thrives on diverse perspectives.

Prima is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Need accommodations during the process? Email us at accessible.recruiting@prima.it. Let’s build the future of insurance, together.

WFP is a 2020 Nobel Peace Prize Laureate.

A career path in WFP provides an exciting opportunity to work across the various country, regional and global offices around the world, and with passionate colleagues who work tirelessly to ensure that effective humanitarian assistance reaches millions of people across the globe.
We offer an attractive compensation package (please refer to the Terms and Conditions section of this vacancy announcement).

In parallel, the Systems Analysis for Nutrition (SAN) team conducts analysis on the cost and affordability of nutritious diets and supports stakeholders in identifying solutions to nutrient gaps through policy and programme design. Both workstreams contribute to strengthening national and WFP capacity in nutrition analytics and evidence-based decision-making.

As Team Lead, the purpose of this position is to manage the two analytical and evidence generation teams within the Nutrition, School Meals and Social Protection Service (PRGS), specifically the MIMI and SAN teams. Under the direct supervision of the Chief of Nutrition, with guidance from the Senior Nutrition Advisor, this position will lead the team and will oversee the development and implementation of the workplans. The Team Lead will be the primary representative for WFP’s Nutrition and Diet analytics, embedded within PRGS to optimize integration with Nutrition, School Meals and Social Protection programming and technical assistance services. The Team Lead will be leading engagement with key internal and external stakeholders, including academia, and supporting the generation, synthesis and use of evidence on nutrition and diets to inform policy and programme decisions.

Provide Strategic Leadership for Nutrition and Diet Research, Analysis, and Methodological Development


Provide strategic oversight and quality assurance for the design, implementation, synthesis, and dissemination of analytical methods and findings, including the responsible use of AI and machine‑learning techniques to strengthen methodological rigor and clear communication of findings to technical and non‑technical audiences;
Direct the strategic mapping, governance, and integration of data sources and indicators informing the development of proxy indicators for dietary vitamin and mineral deficiency (VMD) risks, and diet cost and affordability;
Provide strategic oversight of country‑level nutrition stakeholder consultations, including engagement with senior national counterparts, supervision of qualitative data collection and analysis, and translation of insights into key outputs—particularly the design and functionality of the interactive dashboard.


Identify Strategic Opportunities for New Nutrition and Diet Analytical Opportunities and Lead on their Development


Advise the Chief of Nutrition and the Senior Nutrition Advisor on the strategic direction of nutrition and diet analytics, including opportunities to responsibly leverage AI for improved risk analysis, forecasting, and targeting.
Maintain and strengthen internal partnerships and future collaborations, including collaboration within the Nutrition, School Meals and Social Protection service, with RAM, INNA and other WFP services and divisions relevant to the use of proxy indicators and their visualisation for nutrition and diet-related programming.
Identify potential funding opportunities linked to nutrition and diet analytics.


Establish and Manage Strategic Relationships


Supervise strategic stakeholder engagement at global and national levels, including mapping partners with expertise in AI, data science, and digital public goods relevant to nutrition and diet analytics.
Liaise with Regional and Country Office teams to define analytical needs, timeframes, ToRs, workplans and budgets;
Develop internal and external communication plans to share learning and progress of WFP’s nutrition and diet analytical work;
Provide strategic direction for partnerships with academic and technical institutions (e.g. University of Nottingham, LSHTM, UC Davis), including collaboration on AI‑enhanced methodologies, validation approaches, and applied research.
Manage donor relationships with WFP Partnership’s team, with regular technical meetings, reporting and provision of updates.


Team Management


Lead and manage multidisciplinary teams, including the planning, prioritisation, and delivery of outputs that integrate advanced analytics and AI‑enabled tools for nutrition and diet analytics to enhance efficiency, quality assurance, and scalability.
Provide direct supervision, coaching and performance management for team members to ensure appropriate development and enable high performance;
Manage budgets and resource allocation in collaboration with the Finance Officer, Partnerships Counterparts, Senior Nutrition Advisor, Chief of Nutrition and PGRS Director.

Guide the effective communication of analytical methods, results, and implications to senior national and international audiences, including at high‑level policy and technical fora;
Oversee the translation of complex analytical outputs into accessible, decision‑focused visualizations, working in close partnership with the RAM HungerMapLive team to ensure high‑quality integration of sub‑national data within an interactive dashboard;
Design, coordinate, and provide oversight for dissemination and evidence‑to‑policy uptake strategies, ensuring that data outputs and dashboard insights are effectively leveraged to inform national decision‑making and programming, in close collaboration with WFP Country Offices and key in‑country stakeholders.


Provide Strategic Leadership on Knowledge Sharing of Analytical Insights


Promote knowledge sharing and learning across teams, ensuring alignment with global evidence, corporate priorities, and technical standards.
Coordinate the submission of manuscripts to high‑impact, peer‑reviewed journals, positioning the team’s work as a contributor to global nutrition evidence and methodological innovation;
Represent WFP’s nutrition and diet analytics as a technical thought leader at academic conferences and other relevant forums, strengthening the visibility, credibility, and influence within the global nutrition and food security research community.


Perform Any Other Relevant Duties, As Requested.


Support WFP Corporate work particularly related to nutrition and diet analytics.


QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE

Education: Advanced University degree in Nutrition, or Food Science / Public Health (with a major in Nutrition).

Desired experiences for entry into the role:


Minimum eight years of professional experience in an analytical role in nutrition, some of that on large-scale food fortification or local food solutions would be a plus.
Demonstrated experience supervising large, multi-disciplinary teams of senior and junior analysts to deliver result driven outcomes;
Proven experience conduction and managing research and/or analyses with diverse stakeholders and data inputs, including research design, data collection, analysis and write up, including food and nutrient availability, intake, status, and related health data and modelling data from Household Consumption and Expenditure Surveys to estimate food or nutrient intake or diet access at the individual level;
Experience leading stakeholder engagement to develop evidence-based policy and programme recommendations from evidence and analytics;
Strong track record in building and strengthening operational and policy capacity of national institutions, WFP Country Offices, and technical partners by embedding analytical tools, data products, and evidence‑based approaches into planning, policy formulation, and programme design processes, including through targeted technical guidance and hands‑on support;
Experience presenting analytical findings or evidence to diverse audiences, including government stakeholders, programme staff and academic partners, in a clear and context-relevant format;
Experience representing WFP on high-level academic consortia and committees and globally recognised for contribution to diet and nutrition analytics and the overall global nutrition agenda
Proven ability to build relationships with partners (e.g., donors and governments), negotiating funding, and engaging in resource mobilization.


Language: Fluency (level C) in English language. Intermediate knowledge (level B) of a second official UN language: Arabic, Chinese, French, Russian, Spanish, and/or Portuguese (a WFP working language).

You have:


Functioning knowledge of data landscapes for nutrition, including micronutrients, dietary assessment and household food security.
Proficient in the analysis of quantitative data using statistical software such as STATA and qualitative data using NVIVO.
Expert abilities in diet modelling software, including Cost of the Diet and Optifood.
Experience with artificial intelligence specifically related to food and nutrition analytics
Analytical and problem-solving skills, with a strong solution and action orientation.
Excellent communication, scientific writing, training and facilitation skills.
Flexibility, sound interpersonal skills and cross-cultural sensitivity.
Capacity to coordinate with a range of national and international stakeholders, including national governments, research institutions, private sector, donors and NGO partners.

This is an International Professional position and is open to all nationalities.
Mobility is and continues to be a core contractual requirement in WFP. This position is however classified as “non-rotational” which means the incumbent shall not be subject to the regular reassignment process unless the position is reclassified as rotational.

SU DI NOI

La Fondazione Policlinico Universitario Agostino Gemelli IRCCS si conferma come il luogo in cui competenze scientifiche e tecniche, sensibilità umana, etica e valori cattolici diventano un impegno concreto per cure eccellenti e accessibili all’intera comunità. Il valore che viene quotidianamente posto al centro dell’operare è, fin dalle origini, la cura della persona malata, nel rispetto integrale della sua dignità, dei suoi bisogni, della sua sofferenza e della sua speranza.

LO SAPEVI CHE?

Nel 2018 è stato riconosciuto il carattere scientifico del Policlinico Gemelli per le discipline di “Medicina Personalizzata” e di “Biotecnologie innovative”, diventando un Istituto di Ricovero e Cura a Carattere Scientifico (IRCCS).

Nel maggio 2024, la Fondazione ha conseguito il rinnovo dell’accreditamento triennale come Academic Medical Center da parte della Joint Commission International (JCI), leader mondiale nell’accreditamento in ambito sanitario.

La Fondazione, anche per l’anno 2024, ha ottenuto la conferma (per l’ottavo anno consecutivo) della certificazione Top Employers Italia, prestigioso riconoscimento rilasciato alle Organizzazioni che stabiliscono e mantengono elevati standard nelle pratiche di gestione delle risorse umane, nonché la certificazione “Italy’s Best Employers 2024”.

La Fondazione ha ottenuto il Sigillo Ufficiale “Leader in Diversità e Inclusione 2025”, come struttura che si è distinta in Italia per il proprio operato in termini di diversità e inclusione (D&I) e la Certificazione per la Parità di Genere.

VUOI UNIRTI A NOI?

I PROSSIMI STEPS

Title: JW RETAIL MERCHANDISING
Description:
Position

Within the Jewelry&Watches (JW) Retail Merchandising Department in Rome, we are searching for a JW Retail Merchandising Specialist.

Reporting to the JW Retail Merchandising Manager, the selected candidate will contribute to defining and optimizing product assortment and distribution strategies across all Stores, collaborating with both local and central teams to ensure consistency with product strategy and business performance.

Job responsibilities


Lead and coordinate both Global and Novelties assortment sessions, working closely with Local Merchandisers to define the optimal product assortment for each store based on store clustering, product strategy and sales performance.
Manage and validate assortments for new openings, renovations/relocations and Pop-Up initiatives, coordinating all involved stakeholders (Local Merchandisers, Network Merchandising, Supply Chain, Distribution Planning) to ensure timely and effective implementation.
Monitor and optimize the distribution of products managed on allocation, ensuring alignment with store needs, product priorities and commercial opportunities.
Analyze weekly sales performance, identifying opportunities and proposing actionable recommendations to maximize sell-through, in partnership with Local Merchandisers and Central Departments.
Act as key point of contact for Central Supply Chain and Distribution Planning on assortment-related topics and on priority setting for new product launches.
Support the evolution of assortment and distribution processes, contributing to continuous improvement initiatives and data-driven decision making.


Profile

Qualifications / Professional Capabilities


University Degree in Business Management, Economics, or a related field
4–6 years of experience in merchandising or a similar role, preferably within the luxury or retail industry
Strong quantitative and analytical skills with a high level of accuracy
Excellent knowledge of MS Office applications (especially Excel and PowerPoint); knowledge of Power BI is considered a plus
Fluency in English and Italian


Personal Competencies


Client Orientation
Business Awareness
Product Sensitivity
Analytical and Data-Driven Mindset
Problem Solving
Innovation
Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills

Title: ENERGY MANAGER - TIM SMB
Description:
Nell’ambito di TIM Small&Medium Business, Competence Development Area, stiamo ampliando il nostro presidio nel settore dell'energia dedicata al mercato di riferimento e siamo alla ricerca di una persona per il ruolo di Energy Manager che supporti la gestione strategica e operativa dell'approvvigionamento di energia elettrica e gas, contribuendo allo sviluppo di offerte innovative e alla crescita del business e che avrà un ruolo chiave nel garantire l'equilibrio tra volumi acquistati e venduti, monitorare le performance economiche e supportare l'evoluzione delle soluzioni dedicate ai clienti.

Cosa farai:

Nell’ambito della funzione dedicata, che assicura i ricavi sul segmento SMB utilizzando le leve di marketing (pricing e competitività offerte), CVM (manovre e sconti in retention/prevention), vendita (incentivazione e gestione canali), progettazione e delivery, ti occuperai di:


Gestire i rapporti operativi e contrattuali con fornitori e grossisti di energia.
Coordinare le attività di approvvigionamento sulla base delle previsioni di vendita.
Monitorare l'allineamento tra energia acquistata e venduta, analizzando rischi e scostamenti.
Verificare l'applicazione delle condizioni economiche e contrattuali di fornitura.
Analizzare costi, marginalità e performance economiche dei prodotti energetici.
Collaborare con le funzioni Sales e Marketing per forecasting, pricing e sviluppo di nuove offerte.
Supportare i processi di negoziazione, rinnovo e revisione dei contratti con i partner energetici.


In particolare, tale attività dovrà essere svolta con riferimento al processo di integrazione delle competenze funzionali al percorso di trasformazione aziendale in atto.

Chi sei:

Sei una persona di media seniority con laurea magistrale in Ingegneria Energetica, Ingegneria Gestionale, Economia o discipline affini ed hai maturato una esperienza di almeno 5 anni nel settore energia elettrica e gas. Hai conoscenza dei mercati energetici all'ingrosso e delle relative dinamiche competitive ed esperienza nella gestione di fornitori wholesale e partner energetici.

Possiedi conoscenza dei processi di pricing, forecasting, settlement e portfolio management, con solide capacità di analisi economico-finanziaria, e forecasting ed hai familiarità con la normativa ARERA e con il mercato libero dell'energia.

Dovendo lavorare in un contesto multidisciplinare con numerosi partner e stakeholder, hai attitudine alla negoziazione e alla gestione delle relazioni, sei dotato di problem solving e orientamento ai risultati con capacità di interpretare dati complessi e trasformarli in decisioni operative.

Costituiscono titolo preferenziale: Certificazione EGE (Esperto in Gestione dell'Energia); certificazioni o percorsi specialistici in Energy Management; esperienze in procurement energetico, energy trading o portfolio management.

Cosa offriamo:


Contratto a tempo indeterminato.
RAL di partenza 31.000€, stabilita utilizzando criteri oggettivi e neutrali rispetto al genere. L’offerta economica effettiva potrà ulteriormente incrementarsi, entro parametri prestabiliti, in considerazione dell’evidenza di alcuni criteri di riferimento, quali percorso formativo effettuato, esperienza professionale nel ruolo e complessivamente maturata, certificazioni conseguite e particolare affinità dimostrata rispetto al profilo ricercato
Pacchetto welfare e benefits aggiuntivi.
Formazione continua e percorsi di certificazione.
Possibilità di lavorare in un contesto innovativo e in continua evoluzione, dove potrai contribuire allo sviluppo di nuovi servizi e soluzioni energetiche, collaborando con professionisti qualificati e partecipando a progetti strategici per la trasformazione del business.
Opportunità di crescita in un contesto dinamico e strategico per il presidio delle attività commerciali di TIM.


Sede di lavoro: Roma
